youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Coin Laundromat phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — hunting for a free machine on a rainy night, buying detergent and finding quarters, keeping dark clothes in their own drum, feeding coins in while the washer starts, setting the forty-minute cycle, moving the wet load into a dryer and clearing the lint, folding warm towels and spotting one missing sock, then running home with the basket over your head. No memorising, just press play and let the phrases settle while you drift off. 👍 Tell me which everyday scene to record next, and remember to subscribe and like. #EnglishListening #SleepEnglish #LearnEnglish

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This laundromat is packed tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlɔndrəˌmæt ɪz pækt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚這間自助洗衣店擠滿了人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rainy nights bring everyone in with baskets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈreɪni naɪts brɪŋ ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɪn wɪð ˈbæskəts./
dialogue.zh: 下雨的晚上，大家都抱著籃子跑進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our basket is dripping on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt ɪz ˈdrɪpɪŋ ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們的籃子在地板上滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it by the door and wipe your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr ənd waɪp jʊr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 先放在門邊，把手擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have anywhere to stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈhæv ˈɛnɪˌwɛr tə stænd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們有地方站得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move that white cart and make some room.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðæt waɪt kɑrt ənd meɪk sʌm rum./
dialogue.zh: 把那台白色推車移開，就騰出地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we start looking?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi stɑrt ˈlʊkɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該從哪邊開始找？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washers are on the left, dryers on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑʃərz ɑr ɑn ðə lɛft ˈdraɪərz ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣機在左手邊，烘乾機在右手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the empty machines with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ði ˈɛmti məˈʃinz wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 跟我一起數數看有空機台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see two open ones near the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si tu ˈoʊpən wʌnz nɪr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我看到窗邊有兩台是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number six looks big and free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər sɪks lʊks bɪɡ ənd fri./
dialogue.zh: 六號看起來又大又空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its little light is still on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈlɪtl laɪt ɪz stɪl ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 它的小燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that light a good sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt laɪt ə ɡʊd saɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 那個燈亮是好消息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it means nobody is inside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt minz ˈnoʊbədi ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，代表裡面沒有人在用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red sticker on four worries me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd ˈstɪkər ɑn fɔr ˈwɜriz mi./
dialogue.zh: 四號上那張紅色貼紙讓我擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says broken, please take another one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ˈbroʊkən pliz teɪk əˈnʌðər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫故障了，請改用別台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did someone leave a bag on five?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈsʌmˌwʌn liv ə bæɡ ɑn faɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 五號上面是不是有人放了袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bag has shoes, so five is taken.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bæɡ hæz ʃuz soʊ faɪv ɪz ˈteɪkən./
dialogue.zh: 那袋裡是鞋子，所以五號被佔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that round door on nine closed tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt raʊnd dɔr ɑn naɪn kloʊzd taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 九號那扇圓門是關緊的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed doors mean someone is washing in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd dɔrz min ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪz ˈwɑʃɪŋ ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 門關著就代表有人在裡面洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor mat is soaked through already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr mæt ɪz soʊkt θru ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 門口的地墊都已經濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step off it, the heater will dry your shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ɑv ɪt ðə ˈhitər wɪl draɪ jʊr ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 先離開墊子，暖氣會幫你把鞋子吹乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the one behind the pole?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ði wʌn bɪˈhaɪnd ðə poʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 那根柱子後面那台呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The handle is broken there, see the tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhændəl ɪz ˈbroʊkən ðɛr si ðə teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 那台轉鈕壞了，你看都貼膠帶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So number six is our only hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈnʌmbər sɪks ɪz ˈaʊər ˈoʊnli hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 所以六號是我們唯一的希望了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go claim it before someone else does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ kleɪm ɪt bɪˈfɔr ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɛls dʌz./
dialogue.zh: 快去佔住，別搶先被人用走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I put the basket on top of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt ðə ˈbæskɪt ɑn tɑp ɑv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我把籃子擱在機台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now nobody can grab that machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ˈnoʊbədi kæn ɡræb ðət məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在沒人搶得走那台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This door opens to the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɔr ˈoʊpənz tə ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 這台的門是往前開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I liked the old ones with lids.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪkt ði oʊld wʌnz wɪð lɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 我比較喜歡以前上面有蓋的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a front door harder to load?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə frʌnt dɔr ˈhɑrdər tə loʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 前面開門的比較難放衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you just pull it wide open.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju dʒʌst pʊl ɪt waɪd ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 不會，拉一下就能開得很寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drum inside looks dry and clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drʌm ɪnˈsaɪd lʊks draɪ ənd klin./
dialogue.zh: 裡面的滾筒看起來又乾又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smell it first, though, before we load clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ɪt fɜrst ðoʊ bɪˈfɔr wi loʊd kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 不過先聞一下，再放衣服進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells like soap and warm air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz laɪk soʊp ənd wɔrm ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 聞起來像肥皂和暖暖的空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best smell in this place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst smɛl ɪn ðɪs pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那是這間店最好聞的氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody left lint on the rubber seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌbɑdi lɛft lɪnt ɑn ðə ˈrʌbər sil./
dialogue.zh: 有人在橡膠圈上留了棉屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with this paper towel here.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt wɪð ðɪs ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 用這條廚房紙巾擦掉就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you find that paper towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju faɪnd ðət ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 你在哪裡找到那條紙巾的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the sink, near the soap shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə sɪŋk nɪr ðə soʊp ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 在水槽旁邊，洗衣精架子附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is that a sink over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ðæt ə sɪŋk ˈoʊvər ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，那邊那個是水槽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with two taps and a small mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð tu tæps ənd ə smɔl ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 對，有兩個水龍頭和一面小鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The label on six says forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪbəl ɑn sɪks sɛz ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 六號的標籤寫著四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the whole wash, start to finish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðət ðə hoʊl wɑʃ stɑrt tə ˈfɪnɪʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 那是從頭到尾洗完的全部時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, three settings: hot, warm, cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk θri ˈsɛtɪŋz hɑt wɔrm koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 你看，三種水溫：熱、溫、冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need warm for these work shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid wɔrm fɔr ðiz wɜrk ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 這些上班穿的襯衫用溫水就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this machine take coins or cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs məˈʃin teɪk kɔɪnz ɔr kɑrdz?/
dialogue.zh: 這台是投幣還是刷卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins only, and only the round ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ˈoʊnli ənd ˈoʊnli ðə raʊnd wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 只收硬幣，而且只收圓的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only round ones? What does that mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli raʊnd wʌnz wʌt dʌz ðæt min?/
dialogue.zh: 只收圓的？這是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes quarters, or their own thick tokens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks ˈkwɔrtərz ɔr ðɛr oʊn θɪk ˈtoʊkənz./
dialogue.zh: 它收二十五分的硬幣，或是店裡那種厚代幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have a single quarter?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈhæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈkwɔrtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們身上有一枚二十五分硬幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just three, the jar at home is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst θri ðə dʒɑr æt hoʊm ɪz ˈɛmpti./
dialogue.zh: 只有三枚，家裡那罐硬幣是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, three coins cannot start a wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt θri kɔɪnz ˈkænɑt stɑrt ə wɑʃ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，三枚硬幣開不動洗衣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, there is a coin machine by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks ðɛr ɪz ə kɔɪn məˈʃin baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，門口旁邊有台換幣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That flat window is the price list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt flæt ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ðə praɪs lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那塊平平的玻璃就是價目表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big wash is four dollars, small is three.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ wɑʃ ɪz fɔr ˈdɑlərz smɔl ɪz θri./
dialogue.zh: 大槽洗一次四美元，小槽三美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four dollars for one whole load?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈdɑlərz fɔr wʌn hoʊl loʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 一整籃要四美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheaper than buying new shirts every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipər ðæn ˈbaɪɪŋ nu ʃɜrts ˈɛvri mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 比每個月買新襯衫便宜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side takes the coins, this side?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd teɪks ðə kɔɪnz ðɪs saɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 硬幣從哪邊投入，這邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a small flap under the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl flæp ˈʌndər ðə ˈdaɪəl./
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕下面有個小閘板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flap is stuck with old tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flæp ɪz stʌk wɪð oʊld teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 閘板被舊膠帶黏住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel it slow, do not break the flap.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ɪt sloʊ du nɑt breɪk ðə flæp./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢撕，別把閘板弄壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This dial turns only one way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈdaɪəl tɜrnz ˈoʊnli wʌn weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕只能單向轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we must pick our wash in one go.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi mʌst pɪk ˈaʊər wɑʃ ɪn wʌn ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要一次就選好洗程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man walked in with four bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn wɔkt ɪn wɪð fɔr bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 有個男人提了四個袋子進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He took the long table, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi tʊk ðə lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 他把長桌佔走了，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a table to sort clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ˈteɪbəl tə sɔrt kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我們需要一張桌子來分類衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the small shelf beside machine six.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə smɔl ʃɛlf bɪˈsaɪd məˈʃin sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 用六號旁邊那個小平台吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that shelf clean enough for shirts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ʃɛlf klin ɪˈnʌf fɔr ʃɜrts?/
dialogue.zh: 那平台夠乾淨可以放襯衫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it twice and it will be fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt twaɪs ənd ɪt wɪl bi faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 擦個兩遍就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a magazine on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə ˈmæɡəˌzin ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 上面有人留了一本雜誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it later, we have no time tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt ˈleɪtər wi ˈhæv noʊ taɪm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒再翻，今晚我們趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did machine six just move?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt dɪd məˈʃin sɪks dʒʌst muv?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，六號剛才有沒有動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one on eight is walking sideways.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʌn ɑn eɪt ɪz ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈsaɪdweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，是八號在往旁邊爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do washers walk across floors?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ˈwɑʃərz wɔk əˈkrɔs flɔrz?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼洗衣機會在地板上亂走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too many heavy clothes on one side, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɛni ˈhɛvi kloʊz ɑn wʌn saɪd aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想是重的衣服全堆在一邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will split our load in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl splɪt ˈaʊər loʊd ɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 那我把我們這一籃分成兩半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, but that doubles the coin cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt bʌt ðət ˈdəbəlz ðə kɔɪn kɔst./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，不過硬幣就要花雙倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One big machine is our best deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ məˈʃin ɪz ˈaʊər bɛst dil./
dialogue.zh: 用一台大的對我們最划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, just leave some room inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid dʒʌst liv sʌm rum ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 說好了，滾筒裡要留點空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights here hum like old fans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts hɪr hʌm laɪk oʊld fænz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的燈管嗡嗡作響，像舊電扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like it, it feels like a warm cave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ɪt ɪt filz laɪk ə wɔrm keɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡，像待在一個暖暖的洞穴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cave with four rows of machines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə keɪv wɪð fɔr roʊz ɑv məˈʃinz./
dialogue.zh: 一個排滿四列機器的洞穴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And rain hammering the front glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd reɪn ˈhæmərɪŋ ðə frʌnt ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 還有大雨一直敲打前面的玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that loud beep?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hir ðət laʊd bip?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽到那聲很響的嗶嗶聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the timer on machine two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wəz ðə ˈtaɪmər ɑn məˈʃin tu./
dialogue.zh: 那是二號的計時器響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a bell tells us a wash is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə bɛl tɛlz ʌs ə wɑʃ ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 所以有鈴聲告訴你洗完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then you move everything into a dryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn ju muv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈɪntu ə ˈdraɪər./
dialogue.zh: 對，接著就把衣服全部搬進烘乾機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, whose coat is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ huz koʊt ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，那件外套是誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lady by the door, she works here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi baɪ ðə dɔr ʃi wɜrks hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 門邊那位姊姊的，她在這裡上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask her about the tokens?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æsk hɜr əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtoʊkənz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該去問她代幣的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she knows every coin in this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi noʊz ˈɛvri kɔɪn ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 該問，店裡每一種硬幣她都熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, we need soap and softener too.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst wi nid soʊp ənd ˈsɔfənər tu./
dialogue.zh: 首先，我們還得買洗衣精和柔軟精。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And coins, that machine eats paper bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kɔɪnz ðæt məˈʃin its ˈpeɪpər bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 還要有硬幣，那台吃紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which machine sells the soap bottles?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ məˈʃin sɛlz ðə soʊp ˈbɑtəlz?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一台賣洗衣精？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glass box with the glowing letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡlæs bɑks wɪð ðə ˈɡloʊɪŋ ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 那個玻璃箱子，字母會亮的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glowing letters, you mean that vending machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡloʊɪŋ ˈlɛtərz ju min ðæt ˈvɛndɪŋ məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 字母會亮，你說的是自動販賣機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the one, it never lets me down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə wʌn ɪt ˈnɛvər lɛts mi daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 就是那台，它從來不讓我失望。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our washer is still empty, still ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈwɑʃər ɪz stɪl ˈɛmpti stɪl ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 我們的洗衣機還空著，還是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go quickly, I will guard that big basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ˈkwɪkli aɪ wɪl ɡɑrd ðæt bɪɡ ˈbæskɪt./
dialogue.zh: 快去快回，我幫你顧籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the glass box of soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ɡlæs bɑks ɑv soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣精那個玻璃箱子就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six rows of bottles, all facing out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks roʊz ɑv ˈbɑtəlz ɔl ˈfeɪsɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 六排瓶子，全部瓶身朝外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I read these little letters?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ rid ðiz ˈlɪtl ˈlɛtərz?/
dialogue.zh: 這些小字我要怎麼看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the number under the bottle you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈnʌmbər ˈʌndər ðə ˈbɑtəl ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 按你想要的瓶子下面那組數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty two for the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu fɔr ðə blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 藍色那瓶是二十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the one for dark colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə wʌn fɔr dɑrk ˈkʌlərz./
dialogue.zh: 那瓶就是專洗深色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is liquid better than the powder kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈlɪkwɪd ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə ˈpaʊdər kaɪnd?/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣精比洗衣粉好用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Liquid wins in cold water, she says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪkwɪd wɪnz ɪn koʊld ˈwɔtər ʃi sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 她說冷水裡液體的效果比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is she?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ʃi?/
dialogue.zh: 她是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lady who fills this machine every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi hu fɪlz ðɪs məˈʃin ˈɛvri wik./
dialogue.zh: 就是每個禮拜來補貨的那位姊姊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coins are ready, show me the button.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɔɪnz ɑr ˈrɛdi ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 硬幣準備好了，告訴我按哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the flat slot, not the round one.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə flæt slɑt nɑt ðə raʊnd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 用那個扁的投幣孔，不是圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button is the fabric softener?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən ɪz ðə ˈfæbrɪk ˈsɔfənər?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個是柔軟精的按鈕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, the pink jug with the tall neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðə pɪŋk dʒʌɡ wɪð ðə tɔl nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 九號，粉紅色的、瓶口長長那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really need the softener?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈrɪli nid ðə ˈsɔfənər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們真的需要柔軟精嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your towels come out like sandpaper without it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊr ˈtaʊəlz kʌm aʊt laɪk ˈsændˌpeɪpər wɪˈðaʊt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 要的，不然你的毛巾烘出來會像砂紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are those flat squares on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɑr ðoʊz flæt skwɛrz ɑn tɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那些扁扁的方形是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dryer sheets, they keep the static away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪər ʃits ðeɪ kip ðə ˈstætɪk əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 烘衣紙，可以防止靜電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Static makes my shirts stick to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstætɪk meɪks maɪ ʃɜrts stɪk tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 靜電會讓襯衫黏在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then grab two sheets, one for each dryer round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡræb tu ʃits wʌn fɔr itʃ ˈdraɪər raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 那就拿兩張，每次烘衣放一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this little pen with the red cap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs ˈlɪtl pɛn wɪð ðə rɛd kæp?/
dialogue.zh: 這枝紅蓋的小筆呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is for stains, rub it on first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɔr steɪnz rʌb ɪt ɑn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那是去污筆，先塗一塗再洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stains. My work shirt has three today.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪnz maɪ wɜrk ʃɜrt hæz θri təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 污漬啊，我今天那件襯衫上有三處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the pen is worth every cent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə pɛn ɪz wərθ ˈɛvri sɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 那這枝筆每一分錢都值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press nine now, the pink one.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs naɪn naʊ ðə pɪŋk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 現在按九號，粉紅色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, it dropped into the tray below.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ɪt drɑpt ˈɪntu ðə treɪ bɪˈloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，掉到下面的取貨盤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tray is locked with a coin flap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt treɪ ɪz lɑkt wɪð ə kɔɪn flæp./
dialogue.zh: 取貨盤被投幣閘板鎖住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push your thumb up hard and pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ jʊr θʌm ʌp hɑrd ənd pʊl./
dialogue.zh: 拇指用力往上頂，再拉開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, the pink jug is out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðə pɪŋk dʒʌɡ ɪz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 出來了，粉紅那瓶拿到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the soap, twenty two, try the same trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə soʊp ˈtwɛnti tu traɪ ðə seɪm trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 換洗衣精了，按二十二號，用同樣的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My quarter vanished inside the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkwɔrtər ˈvænɪʃt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə slɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我的硬幣在孔裡面不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake the door softly, do not hit it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ðə dɔr ˈsɔftli du nɑt hɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖一下門，不要敲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your coin come back to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd jʊr kɔɪn kʌm bæk tə ju?/
dialogue.zh: 你的硬幣退回來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is sleeping at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz ˈslipɪŋ æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，它躺在最底下一步也不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wake the attendant lady up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi weɪk ði əˈtɛndənt ˈleɪdi ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該去打擾那位店員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is right there, folding someone's towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz raɪt ðɛr ˈfoʊldɪŋ ˈsʌmwʌnz ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 她就在那邊，幫人摺毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, your machine ate my quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi jʊr məˈʃin eɪt maɪ ˈkwɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你的機器吃掉我的硬幣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says that happens when coins are wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðæt ˈhæpənz wɛn kɔɪnz ɑr wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 她說硬幣濕的時候就會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet coins? Everything is wet tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt kɔɪnz ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪz wɛt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 濕的硬幣？今晚所有東西都是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry them on your sleeve, then try once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ðɛm ɑn jʊr sliv ðɛn traɪ wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在袖子上擦乾，再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It worked, the blue bottle fell down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrkt ðə blu ˈbɑtəl fɛl daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 成功了，藍色那瓶掉下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, patience beats strong hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈpeɪʃəns bits strɔŋ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，耐心比力氣管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we need change for the washers.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi nid tʃeɪndʒ fɔr ðə ˈwɑʃərz./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們得去換洗衣機用的零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The silver box takes bills and spits quarters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪlvər bɑks teɪks bɪlz ənd spɪts ˈkwɔrtərz./
dialogue.zh: 那台銀色的箱子吃紙鈔、吐銀幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feed it your five, slowly this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /fid ɪt jʊr faɪv ˈsloʊli ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 把你的五塊鈔票塞進去，這次慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it pushed the bill right back out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪt pʊʃt ðə bɪl raɪt bæk aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 你看，它把鈔票又推出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the bill is too crumpled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə bɪl ɪz tu ˈkrʌmpəld./
dialogue.zh: 也許是鈔票皺得太厲害了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth it flat against the table edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /smuð ɪt flæt əˈɡɛnst ðə ˈteɪbəl ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 在桌緣上把它抹平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try again, hold the corners straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ əˈɡɛn hoʊld ðə ˈkɔrnərz streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，四個角抓正。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it swallowed it, listen to it count.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈswɑloʊd ɪt ˈlɪsən tə ɪt kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 好，它吞進去了，聽它在數錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve quarters in a shiny row.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈkwɔrtərz ɪn ə ˈʃaɪni roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 十二枚亮晶晶的硬幣排成一列。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dollars in coins, two in bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈdɑlərz ɪn kɔɪnz tu ɪn bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 三美元是硬幣，另外兩美元是紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, twelve quarters is only three?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt twɛlv ˈkwɔrtərz ɪz ˈoʊnli θri?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，十二枚硬幣才三美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each quarter is twenty-five cents, do the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ ˈkwɔrtər ɪz ˈtwɛnti faɪv sɛnts du ðə mæθ./
dialogue.zh: 一枚是二十五分，你自己算算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our big wash costs four whole dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bɪɡ wɑʃ kɔsts fɔr hoʊl ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 我們洗一大槽要花四美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sixteen quarters, plus the dryer after that.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈsɪksˌtin ˈkwɔrtərz plʌs ðə ˈdraɪər ˈæftər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 那就是十六枚，之後烘乾再另外算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixteen quarters is a heavy pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksˌtin ˈkwɔrtərz ɪz ə ˈhɛvi ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十六枚硬幣讓口袋好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry them in a cup, not your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæri ðɛm ɪn ə kʌp nɑt jʊr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 用杯子裝，別用手捧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup by the sink? The paper one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp baɪ ðə sɪŋk ðə ˈpeɪpər wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 水槽那邊的杯子？紙的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, one for coins, one for soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu wʌn fɔr kɔɪnz wʌn fɔr soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩個，一個裝硬幣，一個裝洗衣精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these thick tokens work anywhere else?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz θɪk ˈtoʊkənz wɜrk ˈɛnɪˌwɛr ɛls?/
dialogue.zh: 這些厚代幣別的地方也能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nowhere, they only open the washers here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nəˈwɛr ðeɪ ˈoʊnli ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɑʃərz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 不行，那些代幣只能開這裡的洗衣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I keep them in a jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kip ðɛm ɪn ə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那我就把它們存進家裡的罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, the jar at home will fill again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn ðə dʒɑr æt hoʊm wɪl fɪl əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，家裡那罐終於又有東西了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She handed me a card of tokens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈhændɪd mi ə kɑrd ɑv ˈtoʊkənz./
dialogue.zh: 她給了我一張代幣卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many on the card, eight or ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ɑn ðə kɑrd eɪt ɔr tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 一張有幾個，八個還是十個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight round ones, and a paper slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt raʊnd wʌnz ənd ə ˈpeɪpər slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 八枚圓的，還有一張收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the slip, it proves what you paid.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə slɪp ɪt pruvz wʌt ju peɪd./
dialogue.zh: 收據收好，那能證明你付過錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a token rolls under a machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ə ˈtoʊkən roʊlz ˈʌndər ə məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 要是代幣滾到機器底下怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you lie down and reach for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju laɪ daʊn ənd ritʃ fɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就躺平把手伸進去摸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did that once and found two coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ðæt wʌns ənd faʊnd tu kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 我上次那樣做，還撿到兩枚錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the floor is part of the game.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə flɔr ɪz pɑrt ɑv ðə ɡeɪm./
dialogue.zh: 你看，地板也是這個遊戲的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This soap bottle has no cap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs soʊp ˈbɑtəl hæz noʊ kæp./
dialogue.zh: 這瓶洗衣精沒有蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the tab up, it snaps right off.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə tæb ʌp ɪt snæps raɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 把拉片往上扳，一下就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cap doubles as a measuring cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæp ˈdəbəlz æz ə ˈmɛʒərɪŋ kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 這個蓋子可以當量杯用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one cap, do not pour too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn kæp du nɑt pɔr tu mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 一蓋就夠，別倒太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much soap means endless bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ soʊp minz ˈɛndləs ˈbʌbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 洗劑太多就是一堆洗不完的泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the machine will spill them under the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə məˈʃin wɪl spɪl ðɛm ˈʌndər ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 而且泡泡會從門縫流出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell this softener, it smells like peaches.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ðɪs ˈsɔfənər ɪt smɛlz laɪk ˈpitʃəz./
dialogue.zh: 聞一下這個柔軟精，像桃子味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why the whole place smells sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ðə hoʊl pleɪs smɛlz swit./
dialogue.zh: 難怪整間店聞起來甜甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our shelf is clear, our basket is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ʃɛlf ɪz klɪr ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt ɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我們的平台清空了，籃子也在這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And machine six still waits for our clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd məˈʃin sɪks stɪl weɪts fɔr ˈaʊər kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 六號也還等著吃我們的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we load, we must sort them.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr wi loʊd wi mʌst sɔrt ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 放進去之前，得先分類。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark from light, that is the first rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk frʌm laɪt ðæt ɪz ðə fɜrst rul./
dialogue.zh: 深色和淺色分開，這是第一條規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really have that many darks?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈrɪli hæv ðæt ˈmɛni dɑrks?/
dialogue.zh: 我們真的有那麼多深色衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dump the basket and let us see.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌmp ðə ˈbæskɪt ənd lɛt ʌs si./
dialogue.zh: 把籃子倒出來看看就知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything falls out at once now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ fɔlz aʊt æt wʌns naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在所有東西一次全灑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at that, a sock on your shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðæt ə sɑk ɑn jʊr ʃu./
dialogue.zh: 你看，有一隻襪子掉在你鞋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One sock is already missing tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɑk ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈmɪsɪŋ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚才剛開始就少了一隻襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them later, we have forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðɛm ˈleɪtər wi ˈhæv ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒再數，我們要洗四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes for a wash, forty for a dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts fɔr ə wɑʃ ˈfɔrti fɔr ə draɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 洗四十分，烘也要四十分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost three hours here, on a rainy night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst θri ˈaʊərz hɪr ɑn ə ˈreɪni naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下雨的夜晚，我們要在這裡待近三小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hours in a room full of strangers.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈaʊərz ɪn ə rum fʊl ɑv ˈstreɪndʒərz./
dialogue.zh: 在一個滿是陌生人的房間待三小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are not strangers, they are laundry people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr nɑt ˈstreɪndʒərz ðeɪ ɑr ˈlɔndri ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 他們不算陌生人，是洗衣同好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laundry people, that is a real group.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔndri ˈpipəl ðæt ɪz ə ril ɡrup./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣同好，聽起來像個真正的社團。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come, sit, our pile starts with the darks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm sɪt ˈaʊər paɪl stɑrts wɪð ðə dɑrks./
dialogue.zh: 來，坐下，我們這一堆先從深色開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember how we sort them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju rɪˈmɛmbər haʊ wi sɔrt ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 你還記得怎麼分類嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First the pockets, then the piles.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ðə ˈpɑkəts ðɛn ðə paɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 先掏口袋，再來分堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pockets. Oh no, I left tissues in one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑkəts oʊ noʊ aɪ lɛft ˈtɪʃəz ɪn wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 口袋。糟了，我有一件忘記抽衛生紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then check every pocket first, before anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk ˈɛvri ˈpɑkɪt fɜrst bɪˈfɔr ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那做什麼之前都要先掏口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many piles do we need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni paɪlz du wi nid?/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要分成幾堆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three: darks, lights, and one for towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri dɑrks laɪts ənd wʌn fɔr ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 三堆：深色、淺色，毛巾單獨一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose giant towel is this?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz ˈdʒaɪənt ˈtaʊəl ɪz ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這條超大毛巾是誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours, you packed two, remember the beach?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ju pækt tu rɪˈmɛmbər ðə bitʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 你的啊，你帶了兩條，記得海邊那次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beach was in July, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bitʃ wəz ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 海邊那是七月的時候了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still damp, smell it and you will know.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl dæmp smɛl ɪt ənd ju wɪl noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它還潮潮的，聞一下你就懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, towels go in their own pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈtaʊəlz ɡoʊ ɪn ðɛr oʊn paɪl./
dialogue.zh: 好，毛巾自己堆成一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They go in with the darks tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡoʊ ɪn wɪð ðə dɑrks təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 毛巾今晚跟深色那堆一起洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These shirts are all light blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ʃɜrts ɑr ɔl laɪt blu./
dialogue.zh: 這幾件襯衫都是淺藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights then, with the white socks and tees.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts ðɛn wɪð ðə waɪt sɑks ənd tiz./
dialogue.zh: 那就進淺色那堆，白襪子和T恤也一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tees? You mean these T-shirts?
dialogue.phonetic: /tiz ju min ðiz ˈtiˌʃɜrts?/
dialogue.zh: 短袖？你是說這幾件T恤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the plain ones, no printing on them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə pleɪn wʌnz noʊ ˈprɪntɪŋ ɑn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 對，素色的那幾件，沒有印圖案的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check this jacket pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðɪs ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 讓我掏一下這件外套的口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find anything sharp before it spins?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ʃɑrp bɪˈfɔr ɪt spɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 轉起來之前有沒有找到尖的東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three coins and a folded receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kɔɪnz ənd ə ˈfoʊldəd rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 有三枚硬幣和一張摺起來的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the coins, toss the receipt, it is trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə kɔɪnz tɔs ðə rɪˈsit ɪt ɪz træʃ./
dialogue.zh: 硬幣收起來，收據丟了吧，那是垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A grocery list, still in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈɡroʊsəri lɪst stɪl ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 還有一張買菜清單留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, we need milk anyway tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt wi nid mɪlk ˈɛniˌweɪ təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 念一念，明天反正要買牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone wrote a phone number on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn roʊt ə foʊn ˈnʌmbər ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有人在上面寫了一組電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My cousin's shop, I call it a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzənz ʃɑp aɪ kɔl ɪt ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 是我表哥的店，我常常打給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is a key to some locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə ki tə sʌm ˈlɑkər./
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有一把儲物櫃鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gym one, it fell out of your coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɪm wʌn ɪt fɛl aʊt ɑv jʊr koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 健身房那個，從你外套掉出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good catch, my bag would be locked forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kætʃ maɪ bæɡ wʊd bi lɑkt fərˈɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 還好發現了，不然我的櫃子要永遠鎖著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it on the shelf, out of the wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ɑn ðə ʃɛlf aʊt ɑv ðə wɑʃ./
dialogue.zh: 放在平台上，別一起洗進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pen leaked inside this shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɛn likt ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 這件襯衫裡有枝筆漏了墨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue ink, that needs the pen from the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪŋk ðæt nidz ðə pɛn frʌm ðə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 藍色墨水，得用販賣機買那枝去污筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the stain pen fix ink?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə steɪn pɛn fɪks ɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 去污筆救得了墨水漬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, rub small circles and do not press hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi rʌb smɔl ˈsɜrkəlz ənd du nɑt prɛs hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 也許可以，畫小圈圈地搓，別太用力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lip balm melted in my back pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪp bɑm ˈmɛltəd ɪn maɪ bæk ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我後口袋的護唇膏融化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That white wax is the worst thing in laundry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt waɪt wæks ɪz ðə wɜrst θɪŋ ɪn ˈlɔndri./
dialogue.zh: 那種白蠟是洗衣時最討厭的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrape it off with an old card.
dialogue.phonetic: /skreɪp ɪt ɔf wɪð ən oʊld kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 用一張舊卡把蠟刮掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wash it twice, wax hides in the fabric.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɑʃ ɪt twaɪs wæks haɪdz ɪn ðə ˈfæbrɪk./
dialogue.zh: 然後洗兩遍，蠟會藏在布料裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn your jeans inside out, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn jʊr dʒinz ɪnˈsaɪd aʊt pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請把你的牛仔褲反過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why does that help the color?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðæt hɛlp ðə ˈkʌlər?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼那樣對顏色有幫助？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think it stops the fading.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪt stɑps ðə ˈfeɪdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我想這樣比較不會退色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the rough side rubs the other way.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə rʌf saɪd rʌbz ði ˈʌðər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，磨的那面就朝裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My black jeans are not that black.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ blæk dʒinz ɑr nɑt ðæt blæk./
dialogue.zh: 我的黑牛仔褲已經不太黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They turned gray, the sun did that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ tɜrnd ɡreɪ ðə sʌn dɪd ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 都變灰了，是太陽害的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This red shirt worries me most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rɛd ʃɜrt ˈwɜriz mi moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 這件紅襯衫是我最擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red bleeds, keep it out of the lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd blidz kip ɪt aʊt ɑv ðə laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 紅色會褪色，別放進淺色那堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So red goes with the darks?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ rɛd ɡoʊz wɪð ðə dɑrks?/
dialogue.zh: 所以紅色要跟深色一起洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With cold water, cold keeps the color in.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð koʊld ˈwɔtər koʊld kips ðə ˈkʌlər ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 用冷水，冷水會把顏色鎖住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold for the darks, I have it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld fɔr ðə dɑrks aɪ hæv ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 深色要用冷水，我現在記得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are learning the rules fast tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈlɜrnɪŋ ðə rulz fæst təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你今晚規則學得真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this brown mark on my sleeve?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðɪs braʊn mɑrk ɑn maɪ sliv?/
dialogue.zh: 我袖子上這個棕色痕跡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee, you spilled it in the car again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ju spɪld ɪt ɪn ðə kɑr əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡啊，你又在車子上打翻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rub the stain pen in a small circle.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb ðə steɪn pɛn ɪn ə smɔl ˈsɜrkəl./
dialogue.zh: 用去污筆畫小圈圈擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait five minutes, then it goes in the drum.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt faɪv ˈmɪnəts ðɛn ɪt ɡoʊz ɪn ðə drʌm./
dialogue.zh: 等五分鐘，之後才能丟進滾筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sleeves need more work than the chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slivz nid mɔr wɜrk ðæn ðə tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 袖子比前胸還要多洗一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Underarm marks love warm water and scrubbing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndərˌɑrm mɑrks lʌv wɔrm ˈwɔtər ənd ˈskrʌbɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 腋下那塊最喜歡溫水和搓洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrub? With my hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /skrʌb wɪð maɪ hændz?/
dialogue.zh: 搓？用手搓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the soft brush under the sink tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə sɔft brʌʃ ˈʌndər ðə sɪŋk tæp./
dialogue.zh: 用水槽下面那把軟毛刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do brushes live here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈbrʌʃəz lɪv hɪr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡連刷子都有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two of them, hanging by the detergent shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʌv ðɛm ˈhæŋɪŋ baɪ ðə dɪˈtərdʒənt ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 有兩把，掛在洗衣精架子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wool sweater has a loose sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʊl ˈswɛtər hæz ə lus sliv./
dialogue.zh: 這件毛衣的袖子鬆鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wool shrinks in warm water, keep it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊl ʃrɪŋks ɪn wɔrm ˈwɔtər kip ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 毛衣遇溫水會縮，不要放進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the sweater waits at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈswɛtər weɪts æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 所以那件毛衣先留著在家洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand wash it, or take it to the cleaner.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd wɑʃ ɪt ɔr teɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈklinər./
dialogue.zh: 用手洗，或是送去乾洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt has hooks on the collar.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt hæz hʊks ɑn ðə ˈkɑlər./
dialogue.zh: 我這件襯衫領口有鉤扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close them, hooks grab every other shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðɛm hʊks ɡræb ˈɛvri ˈʌðər ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 把鉤扣好，鉤子會勾到別件襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And these hoodie strings, what about them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðiz ˈhʊdi strɪŋz wʌt əˈbaʊt ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 那這件帽T的繩子怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck them inside, loops catch in the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ðɛm ɪnˈsaɪd lʊps kætʃ ɪn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 把繩子塞進去，繩圈會卡在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found one more dark shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd wʌn mɔr dɑrk ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 我又找到一件深色上衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Throw it on the pile, that pile is huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /θroʊ ɪt ɑn ðə paɪl ðæt paɪl ɪz hjudʒ./
dialogue.zh: 丟過去吧，那堆已經大得不得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the dark pile bigger than the light?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə dɑrk paɪl ˈbɪɡər ðæn ðə laɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 深色那堆比淺色那堆大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much bigger, you wear black all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈbɪɡər ju wɛr blæk ɔl wik./
dialogue.zh: 大太多了，你整週都穿黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drum is half full already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drʌm ɪz hæf fʊl ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 滾筒已經裝一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop packing, clothes need room to move around.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ˈpækɪŋ kloʊz nid rum tə muv əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 別再塞了，衣服要空間才能動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much room, exactly? My hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ rum ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ hænd?/
dialogue.zh: 要留多少空間？我一隻手那麼多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hand flat on top, that is enough space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hænd flæt ɑn tɑp ðæt ɪz ɪˈnʌf speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 上面能平放一隻手就剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I squeeze it in, is that bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ skwiz ɪt ɪn ɪz ðæt bæd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我硬壓進去，會很糟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very bad, the clothes come out still dirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri bæd ðə kloʊz kʌm aʊt stɪl ˈdɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 超糟，衣服拿出來還是髒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the darks go in first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə dɑrks ɡoʊ ɪn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那就先洗深色這一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the lights for a wash next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə laɪts fɔr ə wɑʃ nɛkst wik./
dialogue.zh: 淺色那堆留到下禮拜再洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cap of soap into the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kæp ɑv soʊp ˈɪntu ðə drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 一蓋洗衣精倒進小抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small drawer, not the big wash tub.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl drɔr nɑt ðə bɪɡ wɑʃ tʌb./
dialogue.zh: 是那個小格子，不是整槽洗衣水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softener goes in the blue hole?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔfənər ɡoʊz ɪn ðə blu hoʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 柔軟精倒進藍色那個孔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The flower-marked one, it opens near the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈflaʊər mɑrkt wʌn ɪt oʊpənz nɪr ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 畫小花那個，它會在最後自動放水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the door until it clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə dɔr ənˈtɪl ɪt klɪks./
dialogue.zh: 把門關到喀嚓一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, did you hear that small click?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən dɪd ju hir ðət smɔl klɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，剛剛那聲小小的喀嚓有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard one, did you hear two?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd wʌn dɪd ju hir tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我聽到一聲，你聽到兩聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the latch is shut, the drum is sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə lætʃ ɪz ʃʌt ðə drʌm ɪz sild./
dialogue.zh: 對，門扣卡住了，滾筒封好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hands are wet and slippery now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər hændz ɑr wɛt ənd ˈslɪpəri naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的雙手現在又濕又滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry them on your shirt, save the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ðɛm ɑn jʊr ʃɜrt seɪv ðə ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 用襯衫擦手就好，別弄髒毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shelf still holds the light pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ʃɛlf stɪl hoʊldz ðə laɪt paɪl./
dialogue.zh: 平台上還留著淺色那一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover it with the empty basket, keep it clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvər ɪt wɪð ði ˈɛmpti ˈbæskɪt kip ɪt klin./
dialogue.zh: 拿空籃子蓋住，保持乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sneaky, I like that idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnikɪ aɪ laɪk ðæt aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 狡猾耶，我喜歡這個點子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get ideas only when my hands are busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt aɪˈdiz ˈoʊnli wɛn maɪ hændz ɑr ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 我雙手忙起來的時候才會有這種點子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now coins, water, and a spinning drum.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ kɔɪnz ˈwɔtər ənd ə ˈspɪnɪŋ drʌm./
dialogue.zh: 現在就等硬幣、水和轉動的滾筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coin door is waiting under the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɔɪn dɔr ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə ˈdaɪəl./
dialogue.zh: 投幣門就在轉鈕下面等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight tokens, eight quarters, sixteen in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈtoʊkənz eɪt ˈkwɔrtərz sɪksˈtin ɪn ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 八枚代幣、八枚硬幣，一共十六枚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count in the cup, I will watch the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ɪn ðə kʌp aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə ˈdaɪəl./
dialogue.zh: 在杯子裡數，我看著轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more look at the sorted piles.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr lʊk æt ðə ˈsɔrtəd paɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 最後再看了一眼分好的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Darks are in, lights are covered, all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrks ɑr ɪn laɪts ɑr ˈkʌvərd ɔl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 深色的進機了，淺色的蓋好了，就定位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody touched machine six, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi tʌtʃt məˈʃin sɪks raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 沒有人動過六號，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody, our basket sat there like a guard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt sæt ðɛr laɪk ə ɡɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 沒有人，我們的籃子像保鑣一樣坐在那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us wake this drum up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs weɪk ðɪs drʌm ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 那我們來把滾筒叫醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feed the coins first, it knows nothing yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /fid ðə kɔɪnz fɜrst ɪt noʊz ˈnʌθɪŋ jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 先餵它硬幣，它還什麼都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is shaking a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ɪz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 我的手有點發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is only a washer, yet I feel excited.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli ə ˈwɑʃər jɛt aɪ fil ɪkˈsaɪtɪd./
dialogue.zh: 只是一台洗衣機而已，但我也有點興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the coin door, I will drop them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə kɔɪn dɔr aɪ wɪl drɑp ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 把投幣門打開，我一顆顆丟進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, that is the golden rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn æt ə taɪm ðæt ɪz ðə ˈɡoʊldən rul./
dialogue.zh: 一次一顆，這是黃金守則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First quarter in, did you hear it?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ˈkwɔrtər ɪn dɪd ju hir ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 第一顆進去了，你有聽到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loud clang, like money in a tin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laʊd klæŋ laɪk ˈmʌni ɪn ə tɪn./
dialogue.zh: 很響的一聲，像錢掉進鐵罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second one slides down smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd wʌn slaɪdz daʊn smuð./
dialogue.zh: 第二顆很順地滑下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third is slow, tap the door gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd ɪz sloʊ tæp ðə dɔr ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 第三顆卡卡的，輕輕敲一下門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it? Is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 敲它？這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone here does it, nobody complains.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn hɪr dʌz ɪt ˈnoʊbədi kəmˈpleɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡大家都敲，沒人會抱怨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, five, six, so far so good.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr faɪv sɪks soʊ fɑr soʊ ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 四、五、六，目前一切順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going, ten more and we are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ tɛn mɔr ænd wi ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 繼續，再投十顆就結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixteen coins make my fingers sore.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksˌtin kɔɪnz meɪk maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz sɔr./
dialogue.zh: 十六枚錢投得我手指都痠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six done, ten left, do not lose count.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks dʌn tɛn lɛft du nɑt luz kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 六顆了，還剩十顆，別數錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last one, watch it disappear.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst wʌn wɑtʃ ɪt ˌdɪsəˈpɪr./
dialogue.zh: 最後一顆，看著它消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, the door is full of money now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɔn ðə dɔr ɪz fʊl ɑv ˈmʌni naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不見了，門裡面現在裝滿了錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the coin door just fall shut?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə kɔɪn dɔr dʒʌst fɔl ʃʌt?/
dialogue.zh: 投幣門是自己關起來的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it until it clicks twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt ənˈtɪl ɪt klɪks twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 壓到它喀喀響兩聲為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the dial, warm or cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈdaɪəl wɔrm ɔr koʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 接著是轉鈕，要用溫水還是冷水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold for the darks tonight, like the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld fɔr ðə dɑrks təˈnaɪt laɪk ðə tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚深色用冷水，照標籤說的做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag also says low heat only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tæɡ ˈɔlsoʊ sɛz loʊ hit ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 標籤還寫著只能用低溫烘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low heat then, we will remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ hit ðɛn wi wɪl rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 那就低溫烘，我們會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way does the handle turn?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ dʌz ðə ˈhændəl tɜrn?/
dialogue.zh: 手把要往哪個方向轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clockwise, all the way to the first line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɑkˌwaɪz ɔl ðə weɪ tə ðə fɜrst laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 順時針，轉到第一條刻度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fights me a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt faɪts mi ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 它有點卡卡的，不太肯轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old machines are stiff, give them a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld məˈʃinz ɑr stɪf ɡɪv ðɛm ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 老機器就是硬，給它一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, it clicked into place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt klɪkt ˈɪntu pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好了，它喀一聲定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now press the big start button.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ prɛs ðə bɪɡ stɑrt ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 現在按那個大大的開始鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it with both thumbs?
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt wɪð boʊθ θʌmz?/
dialogue.zh: 用兩個拇指一起按嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thumb is enough, press and let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θʌm ɪz ɪˈnʌf prɛs ənd lɛt ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一個拇指就夠了，按了再放開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, water is coming in loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ˈwɔtər ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ɪn laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，水很大聲地灌進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drum shivers before it turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drʌm ˈʃɪvərz bɪˈfɔr ɪt tɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 滾筒轉動之前會先抖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it stop? Nothing is moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt stɑp ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 停了嗎？都沒東西在動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, it fills with water first, then turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪt fɪlz wɪð ˈwɔtər fɜrst ðɛn tɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，它先注水，才會開始轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it goes, one slow roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɡoʊz wʌn sloʊ roʊl./
dialogue.zh: 開始了，緩緩地滾了一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, three rolls, the sound is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu θri roʊlz ðə saʊnd ɪz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 兩圈、三圈，聲音很好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bubbles are coming through the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ θru ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 泡泡從門縫冒出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin line, soap is doing its job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɪn laɪn soʊp ɪz duɪŋ ɪts dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 細細一條，表示洗衣精在做事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its job is my forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts dʒɑb ɪz maɪ ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 它的工作就是我那四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the window, the water is brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ðə ˈwɔtər ɪz braʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你看視窗裡的水變成褐色的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown? From our clothes?
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn frʌm ˈaʊər kloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 褐色？是我們衣服上的髒東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the last person, maybe, or from dirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə læst ˈpɜrsən ˈmeɪbi ɔr frʌm dɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 也許是上一個人留下的，或者是灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now gray, soon it will run clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɡreɪ sun ɪt wɪl rʌn klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 現在變灰色了，很快就會變清水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how you know it is washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz haʊ ju noʊ ɪt ɪz ˈwɑʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這樣你就知道它真的在洗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something is beeping at the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈbipɪŋ æt ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 牆邊有什麼東西在嗶嗶叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the change machine, out of quarters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə tʃeɪndʒ məˈʃin aʊt ɑv ˈkwɔrtərz./
dialogue.zh: 是換幣機，沒有零錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor machine, nothing left to give.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr məˈʃin ˈnʌθɪŋ lɛft tə ɡɪv./
dialogue.zh: 可憐的機器，什麼都吐不出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor guy beside it, no change tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr ɡaɪ bɪˈsaɪd ɪt noʊ tʃeɪndʒ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 旁邊那位先生更慘，今晚換不到零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our drum is picking speed now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər drʌm ɪz ˈpɪkɪŋ spid naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的滾筒開始越轉越快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clothes climb the wall and fall down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kloʊz klaɪm ðə wɔl ənd fɔl daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 衣服爬上筒壁，再掉下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They tumble like waves in a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈtʌmbəl laɪk weɪvz ɪn ə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 牠們翻滾起來像盒子裡的海浪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm wet wave sound, close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm wɛt weɪv saʊnd kloʊz jʊr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 暖暖的潮濕浪聲，閉上眼睛聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am tired, and it is only eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈtaɪərd ənd ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我累了，現在才八點而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty minutes, then we carry it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts ðɛn wi ˈkæri ɪt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘後，就得抱著這一堆走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy when wet, light when dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi wɛn wɛt laɪt wɛn draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 濕了很重，乾了就很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truth, water doubles every shirt you own.
dialogue.phonetic: /truθ ˈwɔtər ˈdəbəlz ˈɛvri ʃɜrt ju oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 真的，水會讓每件襯衫重一倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is shaking under my shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ˈʌndər maɪ ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 我鞋底的地板在晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the load is even, good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə loʊd ɪz ˈivən ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那代表衣服平衡，是好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even? I thought shaking meant broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən aɪ θɔt ˈʃeɪkɪŋ mɛnt ˈbroʊkən./
dialogue.zh: 平衡？我以為在抖就是壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shaking means it works, banging means trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃeɪkɪŋ minz ɪt wɜrks ˈbæŋɪŋ minz ˈtrʌbəəl./
dialogue.zh: 抖是在工作，撞擊聲才是麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing is banging so far tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz ˈbæŋɪŋ soʊ fɑr təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚到目前都沒有撞擊聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute, machines talk late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt məˈʃinz tɔk leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 再等一下，機器都喜歡晚一點講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh, something clicked wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ oʊ ˈsʌmθɪŋ klɪkt rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 呃糟了，有個聲音卡錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? I hear only water.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr aɪ hir ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？我只聽到水聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside the coin door, a small rattle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə kɔɪn dɔr ə smɔl ˈrætl./
dialogue.zh: 投幣門裡面，有小小的響動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loose coin is stuck in the flap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lus kɔɪn ɪz stʌk ɪn ðə flæp./
dialogue.zh: 有一顆鬆掉的硬幣卡在閘板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it come back out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt kʌm bæk aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 它會退出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, knock the door edge with your knuckles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz nɑk ðə dɔr ɛdʒ wɪð jʊr ˈnəkəlz./
dialogue.zh: 有時候會，用指節敲門邊看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tilt the door or knock it?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪlt ðə dɔr ɔr nɑk ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 是要歪著門還是敲它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knock three times, short and light.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk θri taɪmz ʃɔrt ənd laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 敲三下，短、輕輕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Knock, knock, knock, like a secret.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk nɑk nɑk laɪk ə ˈsikrɪt./
dialogue.zh: 敲、敲、敲，像在對暗號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, the coin dropped into the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə kɔɪn drɑpt ˈɪntu ðə slɑt./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，硬幣掉進孔裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You fixed it, how did you learn that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fɪkst ɪt haʊ dɪd ju lɜrn ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 你修好它了，這招你哪兒學的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother taught me, she did this weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðər tɔt mi ʃi dɪd ðɪs ˈwikli./
dialogue.zh: 我媽教的，她每禮拜都這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekly, in every weather, for thirty years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikli ɪn ˈɛvri ˈwɛðər fɔr ˈθɜrti jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 每禮拜一次，不管天氣，做了三十年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is real skill, not just habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ril skɪl nɑt dʒʌst ˈhæbɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是真的技術，不只是習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dial moved a little on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪəl muvd ə ˈlɪtl ɑn ɪts oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕自己稍微動了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always does, the timer is eating time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlweɪz dʌz ðə ˈtaɪmər ɪz ˈitɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 它總是這樣，計時器在吃掉時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A nice way to say I am losing time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə naɪs weɪ tə seɪ aɪ æm ˈluzɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 你換個說法，像是在浪費我的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are buying forty minutes of clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈbaɪɪŋ ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts ɑv klin./
dialogue.zh: 你是在買四十分鐘的乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes of clean for four dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts ɑv klin fɔr fɔr ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 四美元買四十分鐘的乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap clean, ask anyone in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip klin æsk ˈɛnɪˌwʌn ɪn ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 便宜的乾淨，問問這間店裡任何一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody's dryer is humming a low note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌbɑdiz ˈdraɪər ɪz ˈhʌmɪŋ ə loʊ noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 有人的烘乾機在低低地哼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And ours is splashing in a high key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈaʊərz ɪz ˈsplæʃɪŋ ɪn ə haɪ ki./
dialogue.zh: 我們這台則在高高地潑水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together they sound like a small rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðər ðeɪ saʊnd laɪk ə smɔl reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 合起來聽像下一場小雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real rain on the roof, machine rain inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril reɪn ɑn ðə rʊf məˈʃin reɪn ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 屋頂下的是真雨，屋裡下的是機器雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rain is louder tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ reɪn ɪz ˈlaʊdər təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚哪一種雨比較大聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one on the roof, by far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn ɑn ðə rʊf baɪ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 當然是屋頂那種，差很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our door glass is fogging up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər dɔr ɡlæs ɪz ˈfɔɡɪŋ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我們那台的玻璃開始起霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm air inside the drum, that is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɛr ɪnˈsaɪd ðə drʌm ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 滾筒裡面的空氣是暖的，很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wiped it and saw our shirts spin.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ waɪpt ɪt ənd sɔ ˈaʊər ʃɜrts spɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我擦一下，就看到襯衫在轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So many shirts in a circle, what a show.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni ʃɜrts ɪn ə ˈsɜrkəl wʌt ə ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那麼多襯衫圍成一個圈，真是個表演。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A show for two people and a mop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃoʊ fɔr tu ˈpipəl ənd ə mɑp./
dialogue.zh: 觀眾只有兩個人和一把拖把。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It just stands there and watches too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʒʌst stændz ðɛr ənd ˈwɑtʃəz tu./
dialogue.zh: 它就站在那裡，安靜看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water sounds different now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər saʊndz ˈdɪfərənt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 水的聲音現在不太一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deeper, the soap just dropped in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdipər ðə soʊp dʒʌst drɑpt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 聲音變深了，洗衣精剛剛掉進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what happens next, all the way through?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈhæpənz nɛkst ɔl ðə weɪ θru./
dialogue.zh: 那接下來一路會發生什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It soaks, then rinses, then spins fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt soʊks ðɛn ˈrɪnsəz ðɛn spɪnz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 先浸泡，再沖水，然後快轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then silence, then a bell, then dryers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈsaɪləns ðɛn ə bɛl ðɛn ˈdraɪərz./
dialogue.zh: 然後安靜、鈴響、再進烘乾機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and we carry it all over.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ænd wi ˈkæri ɪt ɔl ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 對，到時把衣服全部搬過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does it count those forty minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ɪt kaʊnt ðoʊz ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 那四十分鐘在哪裡倒數？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That second dial with the little clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɛkənd ˈdaɪəl wɪð ðə ˈlɪtl klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 就是第二個時鐘轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dials here, this is the clock one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdaɪəlz hɪr ðɪs ɪz ðə klɑk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩個轉鈕，這一個是時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you turned it at the start.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju tɜrnd ɪt æt ðə stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 對，你一開始就轉好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sits at forty, did it even move?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts æt ˈfɔrti dɪd ɪt ˈivən muv./
dialogue.zh: 它停在四十，真的有在動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute, this dial is slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnət ðɪs ˈdaɪəl ɪz sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 再等一下，這個轉鈕走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the little flag move too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈlɪtl flæɡ muv tu?/
dialogue.zh: 那個小指標也會跟著移動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, one line every few minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli wʌn laɪn ˈɛvri fju ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 很慢，幾分鐘才走一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is at thirty-nine already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz æt ˈθɜrti naɪn ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 它已經指到三十九了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clock started while we were talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk ˈstɑrtəd waɪl wi wɜr ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 就在我們聊天的時候它開始走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me your pen, I write the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi jʊr pɛn aɪ raɪt ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 給我你的筆，我把時間寫起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On your hand? Like at the doctor's?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn jʊr hænd laɪk æt ðə ˈdɑktərz?/
dialogue.zh: 寫在手上？像看病時那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight o'clock, so eight forty, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt əˈklɑk soʊ eɪt ˈfɔrti jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 八點整，所以是八點四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the finish time, not the start.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈfɪnɪʃ taɪm nɑt ðə stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 寫洗完的時間，不是開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight forty, in blue ink on my wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈfɔrti ɪn blu ɪŋk ɑn maɪ rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 八點四十，用藍筆寫在手腕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we sit, forty is a long time.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi sɪt ˈfɔrti ɪz ə lɔŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們坐下來，四十分鐘很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chairs or bench, which do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛrz ɔr bɛntʃ wɪtʃ du ju wɑnt?/
dialogue.zh: 椅子還是長椅，你想坐哪個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bench by the window, it is warm there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛntʃ baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪt ɪz wɔrm ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 窗邊那張長椅，那邊暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm from the dryers on the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm frʌm ðə ˈdraɪərz ɑn ði ˈʌðər saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 是另一邊的烘乾機傳過去的熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free heat, that is their secret gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri hit ðæt ɪz ðɛr ˈsikrɪt ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 免費的暖氣，那是它們偷偷給的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down, my legs are already tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 坐下吧，我的腿已經很酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, standing is real work here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ˈstændɪŋ ɪz ril wɜrk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，站著在這裡算是工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is at nine percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz æt naɪn pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機剩下百分之九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is an outlet by the magazine rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ən ˈaʊtlɛt baɪ ðə ˈmæɡəˌzin ræk./
dialogue.zh: 雜誌架旁邊有一個插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An outlet, lucky for us both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈaʊtlɛt ˈlʌki fɔr ʌs boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 有插座，我們兩個好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the short cord, the long one is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ʃɔrt kɔrd ðə lɔŋ wʌn ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 用短線吧，長的那條被人拿走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charged, safe, now forty minutes free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɑrdʒd seɪf naʊ ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts fri./
dialogue.zh: 充上了，安心了，現在空出四十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free means bored, do you have a plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri minz bɔrd du ju ˈhæv ə plæn?/
dialogue.zh: 空閒代表無聊，你有安排嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A plan? For laundry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə plæn fɔr ˈlɔndri?/
dialogue.zh: 安排？為了洗衣服？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, books, cards, or a very long nap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʊks kɑrdz ɔr ə ˈvɛri lɔŋ næp./
dialogue.zh: 對啊，看書、打牌，或是好好睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A nap here? On this hard bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə næp hɪr ɑn ðɪs hɑrd bɛntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡睡？睡這張硬長椅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People do it, the hum puts them to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl du ɪt ðə hʌm pʊts ðɛm tə slip./
dialogue.zh: 有人真的這樣，嗡嗡聲很催眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hum is like a big cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hʌm ɪz laɪk ə bɪɡ kæt./
dialogue.zh: 那嗡嗡聲像一隻大貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A purring cat with wet clothes inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpɜrɪŋ kæt wɪð wɛt kloʊz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 一隻打呼的貓，肚子裡裝滿濕衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read me something from that magazine.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid mi ˈsʌmθɪŋ frʌm ðæt ˈmæɡəˌzin./
dialogue.zh: 念一下那本雜誌裡的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is from last spring, look, snow tires.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz frʌm læst sprɪŋ lʊk snoʊ ˈtaɪərz./
dialogue.zh: 是去年春天那期，你看，雪胎專題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snow tires in April, how funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /snoʊ ˈtaɪərz ɪn ˈeɪprəl haʊ ˈfʌni./
dialogue.zh: 四月講雪胎，真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole rack is old news and coupons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl ræk ɪz oʊld nuz ənd ˈkupɑnz./
dialogue.zh: 整架都是舊新聞和折價券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupons for what? Pizza?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkupɑnz fɔr wʌt ˈpitsə?/
dialogue.zh: 折價券是買什麼？披薩？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For soap, mostly, and one for the diner.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr soʊp ˈmoʊstli ənd wʌn fɔr ðə ˈdaɪnər./
dialogue.zh: 大部分是洗衣精，還有一張餐館的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That diner across the street is open late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈdaɪnər əˈkrɔs ðə strit ɪz ˈoʊpən leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 街對面那家餐館開得很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could finish there, after the drying.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɛr ˈæftər ðə ˈdraɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 烘完之後我們可以到那邊收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot chocolate at eleven, that is a plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ˈtʃɑkələt æt ɪˈlɛvən ðæt ɪz ə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 十一點喝熱可可，這才算安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, my treat, you found the tokens.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps maɪ trit ju faʊnd ðə ˈtoʊkənz./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯，我請，代幣是你找到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found nothing, I only carried them.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ˈnʌθɪŋ aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈkæriəd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我什麼都沒找到，我只是在搬東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carrying is the whole job here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæriɪŋ ɪz ðə hoʊl dʒɑb hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，搬來搬去就是全部的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the rules poster on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə rulz ˈpoʊstər ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 看看牆上那張規定海報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number one: no clothes left overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər wʌn noʊ kloʊz lɛft ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第一條：衣服不可以留過夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Overnight, what else does it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt wʌt ɛls dʌz ɪt seɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 過夜，後面還寫了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No washing pets, and no washing shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ pɛts ənd noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 不可以洗寵物，也不可以洗鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No pets? Somebody learned that the hard way.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ pɛts ˈsʌmˌbʌdi lɜrnd ðæt ðə hɑrd weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不能洗寵物？有人用慘痛換來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dog, I heard, a very fluffy dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɔɡ aɪ hɜrd ə ˈvɛri ˈflʌfi dɔɡ./
dialogue.zh: 聽聞是洗了一隻狗，很蓬的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fluffy dog in the coin washer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflʌfi dɔɡ ɪn ðə kɔɪn ˈwɑʃər./
dialogue.zh: 蓬蓬狗丟進投幣洗衣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine spat fur for a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin spæt fɜr fɔr ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 那台機器的毛吐了一整個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee machine or hot water cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi məˈʃin ɔr hɑt ˈwɔtər kʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 要去買咖啡，還是接熱水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee machine, corner, take a small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi məˈʃin ˈkɔrnər teɪk ə smɔl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡機在牆角，拿小杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buttons are dark, I cannot read them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtənz ɑr dɑrk aɪ ˈkænɑt rid ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 按鍵都暗暗的，我看不清字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the second row, plain black coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈsɛkənd roʊ pleɪn blæk ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 按第二排，就是黑咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fills slowly, drip drip drip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪlz ˈsloʊli drɪp drɪp drɪp./
dialogue.zh: 它慢慢裝，滴、滴、滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover the cup, the last drops burn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvər ðə kʌp ðə læst drɑps bɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 蓋住杯口，最後幾滴會燙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too hot already, my fingers know.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt ɔlˈrɛdi maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 已經太燙了，我的手指知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow on it, small breaths, like soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ ɑn ɪt smɔl brɛθs laɪk sup./
dialogue.zh: 吹一下，小口地吹，像喝湯那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar? The packets in the little dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡər ðə ˈpækɪts ɪn ðə ˈlɪtl dɪʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 糖？小碟子裡那些糖包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two brown ones, that is my whole order.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu braʊn wʌnz ðæt ɪz maɪ hoʊl ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 兩包黑糖，我點的就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it long, the sugar hides down.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɜr ɪt lɔŋ ðə ˈʃʊɡər haɪdz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 多攪一會兒，糖都躲在杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pencil works, you have one there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpɛnsəl wɜrks ju ˈhæv wʌn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆也能攪，你手上就有一枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet and warm, forty is better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit ənd wɔrm ˈfɔrti ɪz ˈbɛtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜的暖暖的，現在四十分沒那麼難了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are two minutes in, be patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr tu ˈmɪnəts ɪn bi ˈpeɪʃənt./
dialogue.zh: 我們才等了兩分鐘，耐心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Patient, a word I hate at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪʃənt ə wɜrd aɪ heɪt æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 耐心，這是我最討厭的晚上用詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sleep with your eyes open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn slip wɪð jʊr aɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 那就睜著眼睛睡覺好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lost and found box is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔst ənd faʊnd bɑks ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 遺失招領的紙箱已經滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Umbrellas mostly, plus two single gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌmˈbrɛləz ˈmoʊstli plʌs tu ˈsɪŋɡəl ɡlʌvz./
dialogue.zh: 大多是雨傘，還有兩隻不成對的手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Single gloves, the saddest things here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪŋɡəl ɡlʌvz ðə ˈsædəst θɪŋz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 不成對的手套，是這裡最悲傷的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And socks, see the pair by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd sɑks si ðə pɛr baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 還有襪子，你看門口那一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our gloves are both still here, at least.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ɡlʌvz ɑr boʊθ stɪl hɪr ət list./
dialogue.zh: 我們的手套至少兩隻都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small win, keep it in your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɪn kip ɪt ɪn jʊr ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 小小的勝利，把它收進口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much time left on the clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ taɪm lɛft ɑn ðə klɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 計時器還剩多少時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-six, it went faster than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti sɪks ɪt wɛnt ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 二十六分，比我以為的走得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-six more minutes of drum sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti sɪks mɔr ˈmɪnəts ɑv drʌm saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 還要聽二十六分鐘的滾筒聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will finish this article now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ wɪl ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs ˈɑrtəˌkəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我可以把那篇文章讀完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which article, the dog one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈɑrtəˌkəl ðə dɔɡ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一篇，狗那篇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the one about folding fitted sheets.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði wʌn əˈbaʊt ˈfoʊldɪŋ ˈfɪtəd ʃits./
dialogue.zh: 不，是那篇教人摺松緊床單的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fitted sheets are impossible, everyone knows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪtəd ʃits ɑr ɪmˈpɑsəbəli ˈɛvriˌwʌn noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 松緊床單根本摺不好，大家都知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The magazine claims a trick with two corners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmæɡəˌzin kleɪmz ə trɪk wɪð tu ˈkɔrnərz./
dialogue.zh: 雜誌說有個用兩角的訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two corners, then a tuck, then hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɔrnərz ðɛn ə tʌk ðɛn hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 兩個角對起來，塞一下，然後祈禱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it on our sheet tonight, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt ɑn ˈaʊər ʃit təˈnaɪt ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 今晚回家慢慢試我們的床單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our sheet is old, it has a hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ʃit ɪz oʊld ɪt hæz ə hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我們的床單舊了，還破了一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sew it, or buy a new one Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt ɔr baɪ ə nu wʌn ˈsʌndeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 縫一縫，或是禮拜天買新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday, the day with no errands at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌndeɪ ðə deɪ wɪð noʊ ˈɛrəndz æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 禮拜天是最不需要跑腿的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Errands, plural, we are doing one right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛrəndz ˈplʊrəl wi ɑr duɪŋ wʌn raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 跑腿很多件，我們現在就在跑其中一件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes left, I checked twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts lɛft aɪ tʃɛkt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 還剩二十分鐘，我檢查了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will hold the cups, you walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə kʌps ju wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 好，我拿著杯子，你去走一走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk where? The room is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk wɛr ðə rum ɪz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 走去哪裡？這間店本來就不大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk the rows, stretch your back a bit.
