dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ðə roʊz strɛtʃ jʊr bæk ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沿著機器走一排，伸展一下背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row one is soap, row two is rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ wʌn ɪz soʊp roʊ tu ɪz reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 第一排是洗衣精，第二排是雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row three is dryers waiting to be filled.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ θri ɪz ˈdraɪərz ˈweɪtɪŋ tə bi fɪld./
dialogue.zh: 第三排是等著被裝滿的烘乾機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filled with our wet pile in twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪld wɪð ˈaʊər wɛt paɪl ɪn ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘後就輪到我們那堆濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm piles, that is the best part.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm paɪlz ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 烘得熱熱的一堆，那是最好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wrist says almost eight forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪst sɛz ˈɔlmoʊst eɪt ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 我手腕上寫著快八點四十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, the drum is slowing right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə drʌm ɪz ˈsloʊɪŋ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，滾筒現在正在變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That spin is ending, hold the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt spɪn ɪz ˈɛndɪŋ hoʊld ðə ˈbæskɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那陣旋轉要結束了，把籃子拿好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it open, ready for the wet clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈoʊpən ˈrɛdi fɔr ðə wɛt kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 門打開了，準備接濕衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is the bell, eight forty sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ðə bɛl eɪt ˈfɔrti ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 鈴響了，八點四十整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the door slow, water will run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr sloʊ ˈwɔtər wɪl rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 門慢慢開，水會流出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is heavy, this whole pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi ðɪs hoʊl paɪl./
dialogue.zh: 這一整堆抱起來好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift with both arms, it is warm too.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft wɪð boʊθ ɑrmz ɪt ɪz wɔrm tu./
dialogue.zh: 用兩邊手臂抱，它還熱熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt front is wet already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt frʌnt ɪz wɛt ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我前面的衣服已經被弄濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand back, I will pull the sleeves out.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd bæk aɪ wɪl pʊl ðə slivz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 你先退開，我把袖子一件件拉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything out? Even the small socks?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ aʊt ˈivən ðə smɔl sɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 全部拿出來？小襪子也要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even those, the drum eats small things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðoʊz ðə drʌm its smɔl θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 連那些都要，滾筒最愛吃小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the basket sags in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈbæskɪt sæɡz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 現在籃子中間都軟軟地垂下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry it low, keep your back straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæri ɪt loʊ kip jʊr bæk streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 抱低一點，腰要打直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dryer is the free one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈdraɪər ɪz ðə fri wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一台烘乾機是空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number three, the wide one at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər θri ðə waɪd wʌn æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 三號，最後面寬寬的那台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three it is, open that big mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪt ɪz ˈoʊpən ðæt bɪɡ maʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 就三號，把那張大嘴打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it wide, hold the door back.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl aɪt waɪd hoʊld ðə dɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 把門拉開，撐住別讓它彈回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside is cold, it has not run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz koʊld ɪt hæz nɑt rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 裡面是涼的，代表沒人用過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it is clean, dump everything in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɪt ɪz klin dʌmp ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 很好，也乾淨，整堆倒進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All of it? That is a big load.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ʌv ɪt ðæt ɪz ə bɪɡ loʊd./
dialogue.zh: 全部倒進去？那一堆很大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Split it, two dryers, faster and cheaper.
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt ɪt tu ˈdraɪərz ˈfæstər ənd ˈtʃipər./
dialogue.zh: 分兩台，乾得快又省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, take the towels to number four.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt teɪk ðə ˈtaʊəlz tə ˈnʌmbər fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，毛巾拿去四號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four is warm already, someone just left.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪz wɔrm ɔlˈrɛdi ˈsʌmˌwʌn dʒʌst lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 四號還溫溫的，剛剛有人離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean it first, look, hair on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ɪt fɜrst lʊk hɛr ɑn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先清一下，你看門上有一撮毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tissue, not hair, and a dry leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪʃu nɑt hɛr ənd ə draɪ lif./
dialogue.zh: 是衛生紙啦，不是毛，還有一片乾葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a screen inside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə skrin ɪnˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門的內側有一片濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lint trap, pull it out, empty it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪnt træp pʊl ɪt aʊt ˈɛmpti ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是棉屑濾網，抽出來倒乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is full of gray fuzz.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fʊl ɑv ɡreɪ fʌz./
dialogue.zh: 上面堆滿灰灰的棉絮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft pillow of other people's clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft ˈpɪloʊ ɑv ˈʌðər ˈpipəlz kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 像個軟軟的枕頭，是別人的衣服做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put this fuzz?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt ðɪs fʌz?/
dialogue.zh: 這堆棉絮我要丟到哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The round bin beside the door, dump it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raʊnd bɪn bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr dʌmp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 門旁邊那個圓垃圾桶，倒進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does it matter so much?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ɪt ˈmætər soʊ mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼這件事情那麼重要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A clean screen dries faster, saves your coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə klin skrin draɪz ˈfæstər seɪvz jʊr kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 濾網乾淨乾得快，也能省硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saving coins, I like that rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪvɪŋ kɔɪnz aɪ laɪk ðæt rul./
dialogue.zh: 能省硬幣，我喜歡這條規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screen clean, door shut, now the coins again.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrin klin dɔr ʃʌt naʊ ðə kɔɪnz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 濾網清好、門關上，又輪到硬幣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dryers, six coins, do we have six?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdraɪərz sɪks kɔɪnz du wi hæv sɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 兩台要六枚，我們手上有六枚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the sticker, three for thirty, we have seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðə ˈstɪkər θri fɔr ˈθɜrti wi hæv ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 看貼紙，三枚烘三十分鐘，我們剛好有七枚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three coins, and the heat choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kɔɪnz ənd ðə hit tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 三枚硬幣，還要選熱度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: High for towels, low for your shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ fɔr ˈtaʊəlz loʊ fɔr jʊr ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 毛巾用高溫，你的襯衫用低溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low for the shirts, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ fɔr ðə ʃɜrts ʌv kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 襯衫低溫，當然要低溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They shrink on high, I learned that once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃrɪŋk ɑn haɪ aɪ lɜrnd ðæt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 高溫會讓衣服縮，我吃過一次教訓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One time was enough for anyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn taɪm wəz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ˈɛnɪˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 一次就夠任何人學乖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My good blue shirt became a kid's size.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡʊd blu ʃɜrt bɪˈkeɪm ə kɪdz saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我那件好看的藍襯衫變成小孩尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A kid's size, hanging in my closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɪdz saɪz ˈhæŋɪŋ ɪn maɪ ˈklɑzət./
dialogue.zh: 小孩尺寸，還掛在我衣櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frame it, it is a lesson now.
dialogue.phonetic: /freɪm ɪt ɪt ɪz ə ˈlɛsən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 把它裱起來吧，那現在是教材了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start it, I want that warm air.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt ɪt aɪ wɑnt ðæt wɔrm ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 啟動吧，我想要那陣暖風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press, then listen for the big roar.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðɛn ˈlɪsən fɔr ðə bɪɡ rɔr./
dialogue.zh: 按一下，然後聽那聲大大的轟響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, like an old plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz laɪk ən oʊld pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 來了，像一架老飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud and warm, the best sound at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ənd wɔrm ðə bɛst saʊnd æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 又吵又暖，是晚上最好聽的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The windows fog on this side too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊz fɔɡ ɑn ðɪs saɪd tu./
dialogue.zh: 這邊的窗也開始起霧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our water leaving the clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər ˈwɔtər ˈlivɪŋ ðə kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 是我們衣服裡的水正在離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our water into the outside air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈwɔtər ˈɪntu ði ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們的水飛到外面的空氣裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the rain, which is funny somehow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə reɪn wɪtʃ ɪz ˈfʌni ˈsʌmˌhaʊ./
dialogue.zh: 飛進雨裡，說起來有點好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes now, then the folding.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnəts naʊ ðɛn ðə ˈfoʊldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在烘三十分，接下來就是摺衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on your other wrist, quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn jʊr ˈʌðər rɪst kwɪk./
dialogue.zh: 快寫在你另一邊的手腕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight forty-five, or nine o'clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈfɔrti faɪv ɔr naɪn əˈklɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 八點四十五，還是九點整？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine fifteen, and then the folding.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn fɪfˈtin ænd ðɛn ðə ˈfoʊldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 九點十五，然後就摺衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer is slow, the coins are fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmər ɪz sloʊ ðə kɔɪnz ɑr fæst./
dialogue.zh: 計時器走得慢，錢包倒是很快速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truth, that five-dollar bill is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /truθ ðæt ˈfaɪv ˈdɑlər bɪl ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 真的，那張五美元的鈔票花光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five dollars, and we are not done.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑlərz ənd wi ɑr nɑt dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 五美元了，而且我們還沒弄完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not done, we still need the last fold.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt dʌn wi stɪl nid ðə læst foʊld./
dialogue.zh: 沒完，最後還得全部摺一摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody left a chair open here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌbʌdi lɛft ə tʃɛr ˈoʊpən hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 有人在這裡空了一張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, relax your legs, I will watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt rɪˈlæks jʊr lɛɡz aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 坐吧，腿休息，我來看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You watch, I will doze a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑtʃ aɪ wɪl doʊz ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 你看著，我小睡一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doze with one ear open, the bell is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊz wɪð wʌn ɪr ˈoʊpən ðə bɛl ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 睜一隻耳再睡，鈴聲很小聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One ear, okay, I trust you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪr oʊˈkeɪ aɪ trʌst ju./
dialogue.zh: 一隻耳朵，好，我信你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, I only want clean shirts too.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst mi aɪ ˈoʊnli wɑnt klin ʃɜrts tu./
dialogue.zh: 放心，我也只想要乾淨的襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those lights above us are buzzing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz laɪts əˈbʌv ʌs ɑr ˈbʌzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們頭上的燈在嗡嗡叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One flicks when the dryers start.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn flɪks wɛn ðə ˈdraɪərz stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 有一盞會在烘乾機啟動時閃一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flicks, like the room is thinking.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪks laɪk ðə rum ɪz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 閃一下，像這間店在思考。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room is thinking about your socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt jʊr sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 它想的應該是你的襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My socks are tumbling in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑks ɑr ˈtʌmbəlɪŋ ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我的襪子在裡面翻滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alone, small, spinning, a sad little show.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn smɔl ˈspɪnɪŋ ə sæd ˈlɪtl ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 孤單、小小的、一直轉，可憐的節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the lady is folding fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈleɪdi ɪz ˈfoʊldɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 你看，那位姊姊摺得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every towel in half, then half again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈtaʊəl ɪn hæf ðɛn hæf əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 每條毛巾對折，再對折一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She folds like she is playing cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi foʊldz laɪk ʃi ɪz ˈpleɪɪŋ kɑrdz./
dialogue.zh: 她摺衣服像在打牌一樣熟練。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her to teach us after this.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr tə titʃ ʌs ˈæftər ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 等會兒請她教我們兩招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe later, my shirt still feels damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ˈleɪtər maɪ ʃɜrt stɪl filz dæmp./
dialogue.zh: 等一下再說，我的襯衫摸起來還潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Damp sleeves need ten more minutes, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp slivz nid tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 潮袖子一定要再多烘十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten more coins? Or ten more minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr kɔɪnz ɔr tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts?/
dialogue.zh: 再十枚硬幣？還是再多十分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Minutes, one more quarter turns them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪnəts wʌn mɔr ˈkwɔrtər tɜrnz ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 是分鐘，再一枚硬幣就會轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One quarter buys ten warm minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkwɔrtər baɪz tɛn wɔrm ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 一枚硬幣買到十分鐘的暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best money in this whole town.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst ˈmʌni ɪn ðɪs hoʊl taʊn./
dialogue.zh: 是這整個城裡最划算的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it, feel that heat on your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt fil ðæt hit ɑn jʊr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 開門，讓那熱風撲在你的臉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like summer, a hot summer in a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈsʌmər ə hɑt ˈsʌmər ɪn ə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 像夏天，一個裝在箱子裡的熱夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smell is warm cotton and soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl ɪz wɔrm ˈkɑtn ənd soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 味道是暖暖的棉和肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That smell is why people come back here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smɛl ɪz waɪ ˈpipəl kʌm bæk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那個味道就是大家回來的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am coming back for that smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈkʌmɪŋ bæk fɔr ðæt smɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我下次回來也是為了那個味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And for the warm bench and the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd fɔr ðə wɔrm bɛntʃ ənd ðə ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 還有暖暖的長椅和那杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine twenty, the last bell soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈtwɛnti ðə læst bɛl sun./
dialogue.zh: 九點二十分了，最後一聲鈴快到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon, then we own the big folding shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðɛn wi oʊn ðə bɪɡ ˈfoʊldɪŋ ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 快了，到時整個大平台都是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shelf is ours, the man moved out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf ɪz ˈaʊərz ðə mæn muvd aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 平台是我們的了，那個男人收完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He left one peg and a clothes hanger.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lɛft wʌn pɛɡ ənd ə kloʊz ˈhæŋər./
dialogue.zh: 他留下一個掛鉤和一支衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hanger, useful, keep it for shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhæŋər ˈjusfəl kip ɪt fɔr ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 衣架，很有用，留給襯衫用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang them on the rod, fold the rest flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðɛm ɑn ðə rɑd foʊld ðə rɛst flæt./
dialogue.zh: 掛在那根桿上，其他的摺得平平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dryers are stopping one by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪərz ɑr ˈstɑpɪŋ wʌn baɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 烘乾機一台一台停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is last, listen, it is still roaring.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ɪz læst ˈlɪsən ɪt ɪz stɪl ˈrɔrɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們那台最後才停，你聽，還在轟轟叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still roaring, still warm, still tumbling.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈrɔrɪŋ stɪl wɔrm stɪl ˈtʌmbəlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 還轟轟、還熱熱、還在翻滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And when it stops, we will have clean piles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd wɛn ɪt stɑps wi wɪl hæv klin paɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 等它一停，我們就有乾淨的衣服堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean piles, dry hands, one more task.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin paɪlz draɪ hændz wʌn mɔr tæsk./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的衣服、乾的手，還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folding, all of it, before eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldɪŋ ɔl ʌv ɪt bɪˈfɔr ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 在十一點前，全部摺一摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let it cool two minutes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt kul tu ˈmɪnəts fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先讓它涼個兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool ones fold flat, warm ones stay big.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul wʌnz foʊld flæt wɔrm wʌnz steɪ bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 涼一點才摺得平，熱的會膨起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine twenty-five, the last bell, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈtwɛnti faɪv ðə læst bɛl ˈpɜrfɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 九點二十五分，最後一聲鈴，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry, all of it, touch this sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɔl ʌv ɪt tʌtʃ ðɪs sliv./
dialogue.zh: 乾了，全都乾了，你摸摸這袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm as bread, I am not joking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm æz brɛd aɪ æm nɑt dʒoʊkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 像麵包一樣暖，我沒在開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm bread out of an oven, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm brɛd aʊt ɑv æn ˈʌvən ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就是剛從烤箱拿出來的麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dump the warm pile on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌmp ðə wɔrm paɪl ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 把熱熱的那堆倒上平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes a mountain, a soft mountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪks ə ˈmaʊntən ə sɔft ˈmaʊntən./
dialogue.zh: 變成一座山，一座軟軟的山。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Towels first, they are the biggest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəlz fɜrst ðeɪ ɑr ðə ˈbɪɡɪst./
dialogue.zh: 先摺毛巾，它們是最大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half, then half, then smooth with your palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðɛn hæf ðɛn smuð wɪð jʊr pɑm./
dialogue.zh: 對折、再對折，然後用手掌壓平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My palm leaves a flat line.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ pɑm livz ə flæt laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我手掌壓過留下一條平線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the trick, the lady does it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə trɪk ðə ˈleɪdi dʌz ɪt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 這就是訣竅，那位姊姊做得超快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve towels, how many are ours?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈtaʊəlz haʊ ˈmɛni ɑr ˈaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 十二條毛巾，有幾條是我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just our two, all the rest are theirs.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈaʊər tu ɔl ðə rɛst ɑr ðɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 只有我們那兩條，其他都是別人的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their big gray one, with the hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr bɪɡ ɡreɪ wʌn wɪð ðə hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 那條灰色的大毛巾，還破一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it back, the owner will look soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt bæk ði ˈoʊnər wɪl lʊk sun./
dialogue.zh: 放回去吧，主人一下就會回頭找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shirts next, hang them while warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɜrts nɛkst hæŋ ðɛm waɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 接下來襯衫，趁熱掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hanger we found, is it clean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhæŋər wi faʊnd ɪz ɪt klin?/
dialogue.zh: 我們撿到的那個衣架，乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe it with your sleeve, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt wɪð jʊr sliv dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 用袖子擦一下就乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four shirts on the rod, no wrinkles now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ʃɜrts ɑn ðə rɑd noʊ ˈrɪŋkəlz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 四件襯衫掛在桿上，現在都沒皺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No wrinkles, that is a small miracle.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈrɪŋkəlz ðæt ɪz ə smɔl ˈmɪrəkəl./
dialogue.zh: 沒有皺褶，這是個小奇蹟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miracles cost more coins here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪrəkəls kɔst mɔr kɔɪnz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡奇蹟要再多花硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the magazine trick, the sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈmæɡəˌzin trɪk ðə ʃit./
dialogue.zh: 現在來試雜誌那一招，床單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two corners, thumb to thumb, then tuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɔrnərz θʌm tə θʌm ðɛn tʌk./
dialogue.zh: 兩角對齊、拇指貼拇指，再往內塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? My thumbs are slipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs maɪ θʌmz ɑr ˈslɪpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？我的拇指一直在滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closer, the corners must meet exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊsər ðə ˈkɔrnərz mʌst mit ɪɡˈzæktli./
dialogue.zh: 再近一點，兩個角要剛好對上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They meet, now what, where do I pull?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ mit naʊ wʌt wɛr du aɪ pʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 對上了，然後呢，我要往哪拉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull down along the seam, slowly, there.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl daʊn əˈlɔŋ ðə sim ˈsloʊli ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 沿著縫線往下拉，慢慢的，就那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It folded, actually folded, look!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈfoʊldəd ˈæktʃuəli ˈfoʊldəd lʊk!/
dialogue.zh: 它摺起來了，真的摺起來了，你看！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did it, the magazine was right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ɪt ðə ˈmæɡəˌzin wəz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你做到了，那本雜誌是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write that on my wrist too.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt ɑn maɪ rɪst tu./
dialogue.zh: 也把這件事寫在我手腕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sock time now, the serious part.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑk taɪm naʊ ðə ˈsɪriəs pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 現在是襪子時間，最嚴肅的環節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Serious, yes, socks are my enemy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪriəs jɛs sɑks ɑr maɪ ˈɛnəmi./
dialogue.zh: 很嚴肅，襪子本來就是我的敵人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them on the shelf, in pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðɛm ɑn ðə ʃɛlf ɪn pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 在平台上數，兩兩一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, four, six, eight, ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu fɔr sɪks eɪt tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 二、四、六、八、十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven? Eleven is a bad number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ɪˈlɛvən ɪz ə bæd ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 十一？十一是一個壞數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One sock is gone, again tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɑk ɪz ɡɔn əˈɡɛn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 又少了一隻襪子，就在今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We counted one missing at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkaʊntɪd wʌn ˈmɪsɪŋ æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 八點時我們就算少了一隻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it vanished inside the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt ˈvænɪʃt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 所以它消失在機器裡面了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or it hid in a sleeve of your shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ɪt hɪd ɪn ə sliv ɑv jʊr ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 或是躲在某件襯衫的袖子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check my shirt sleeves, all four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk maɪ ʃɜrt slivz ɔl fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 檢查我襯衫的袖子，四件都查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty, empty, empty, and nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti ˈɛmpti ˈɛmpti ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 空的、空的、空的，什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dryer drum, look inside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈdraɪər drʌm lʊk ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 烘乾機的滾筒，往裡面看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need a light, use your flashlight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə laɪt juz jʊr ˈflæʃlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我需要光，用你的手電筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flashlight on, see anything white?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflæʃlaɪt ɑn si ˈɛniˌθɪŋ waɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 手電筒打開，看得到白色的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only lint, and one old coin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli lɪnt ənd wʌn oʊld kɔɪn./
dialogue.zh: 只有棉屑，還有一枚舊硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A coin! Keep it, that is lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɔɪn kip ɪt ðæt ɪz lʌntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 有硬幣！收起來，那是午餐錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lunch from a laundry floor, rich life.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌntʃ frʌm ə ˈlɔndri flɔr rɪtʃ laɪf./
dialogue.zh: 從洗衣店地板撿來的午餐，好闊氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lint screen, check the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪnt skrin tʃɛk ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 濾網，檢查一下那個濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing but gray fuzz, feel here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ bʌt ɡreɪ fʌz fil hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 只有灰灰的棉絮，你摸摸這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing. Our sock has a secret.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈaʊər sɑk hæz ə ˈsikrɪt./
dialogue.zh: 都沒有，我們那隻襪子有秘密。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Secrets live under machines, get down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsikrədz lɪv ˈʌndər məˈʃinz ɡɛt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 秘密都住在機器底下，蹲下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the floor? In my clean jeans?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə flɔr ɪn maɪ klin dʒinz?/
dialogue.zh: 在地板上？在我剛洗乾淨的牛仔褲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jeans get dirty here, that is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒinz ɡɛt ˈdɜrti hɪr ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 牛仔褲在這裡一定會變髒，沒辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is under number three.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ɪz ˈʌndər ˈnʌmbər θri./
dialogue.zh: 我的手伸到三號底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reach slow, watch the hot metal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ritʃ sloʊ wɑtʃ ðə hɑt ˈmɛtəl./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢伸手，小心燙燙的金屬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm metal, dust, a hair tie.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈmɛtəl dʌst ə hɛr taɪ./
dialogue.zh: 溫溫的金屬、灰塵、一根頭髮圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going, your fingers know the shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ jʊr ˈfɪŋɡərz noʊ ðə ʃeɪp./
dialogue.zh: 繼續摸，你的手指認得那個形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a button and one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ə ˈbʌtən ənd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我摸到一顆扣子，還有一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes? Yes? Is it white with gray stripes?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jɛs ɪz ɪt waɪt wɪð ɡreɪ straɪps?/
dialogue.zh: 對嗎對嗎？是白的帶灰色條紋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a sock! It is ours!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə sɑk ɪt ɪz ˈaʊərz!/
dialogue.zh: 是襪子！是我們的那隻！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show it, hold it up, like a flag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ɪt hoʊld ɪt ʌp laɪk ə flæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 舉起來給我們看，像舉一面旗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One gray sock, saved from the dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡreɪ sɑk seɪvd frʌm ðə dʌst./
dialogue.zh: 一隻灰襪子，從灰塵裡獲救。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake it outside, then pair it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɪt ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ðɛn pɛr ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 到門外抖一抖，再配成一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve socks, six happy pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv sɑks sɪks ˈhæpi pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 十二隻襪子，六對開心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six pairs, that is a record for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks pɛrz ðæt ɪz ə ˈrɛkərd fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 六對，對我們來說是新紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A record in laundry, I am proud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɛkərd ɪn ˈlɔndri aɪ æm praʊd./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣界的紀錄，我有點驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proud of socks, this is our life now.
dialogue.phonetic: /praʊd ɑv sɑks ðɪs ɪz ˈaʊər laɪf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 為襪子驕傲，我們的人生就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the smalls now, boxers and tees.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ðə smɔlz naʊ ˈbɑksərz ənd tiz./
dialogue.zh: 來摺小件的，內褲和短袖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Square them, edge to edge, then stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwɛr ðɛm ɛdʒ tə ɛdʒ ðɛn stæk./
dialogue.zh: 摺成正方形，邊對邊，然後疊起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stack tall enough to fall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stæk tɔl ɪˈnʌf tə fɔl./
dialogue.zh: 疊高到隨時會倒的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three high, no more, it is a tower.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri haɪ noʊ mɔr ɪt ɪz ə ˈtaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 三件就好，再多就變成塔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Socks on top, they get lost last.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑks ɑn tɑp ðeɪ ɡɛt lɔst læst./
dialogue.zh: 襪子放最上面，就不會那麼快不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, a rule from the missing sock club.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvər ə rul frʌm ðə ˈmɪsɪŋ sɑk klʌb./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，襪子失蹤俱樂部的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The missing sock club has two members.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪsɪŋ sɑk klʌb hæz tu ˈmɛmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 襪子失蹤俱樂部有兩個會員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight it has zero, we closed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ɪt hæz ˈzɪroʊ wi kloʊzd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚會員是零，我們關店了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed forever, unless you wash again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd fərˈɛvər ʌnˈlɛs ju wɑʃ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 永久歇業，除非你又洗衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will, next Sunday, with a full jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl nɛkst ˈsʌndeɪ wɪð ə fʊl dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我們會再來的，下禮拜，帶著滿滿一罐硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything folded, look at the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈfoʊldəd lʊk æt ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 全部摺完了，看看這個平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four neat piles and one tall tower.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr nit paɪlz ənd wʌn tɔl ˈtaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 四堆整整齊齊，還有一座高塔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neat piles, that is me? Impossible.
dialogue.phonetic: /nit paɪlz ðæt ɪz mi ɪmˈpɑsəbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 整齊的衣服堆，這是我？不可能。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a laundry person now, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ə ˈlɔndri ˈpɜrsən naʊ ˈtruːli./
dialogue.zh: 你現在真的是個洗衣的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I accept, put the piles in the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əkˈsɛpt pʊt ðə paɪlz ɪn ðə ˈbæskɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我承認，把衣服堆放進籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Softest on the bottom, towels on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔfəst ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəm ˈtaʊəlz ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 最軟的放最底，毛巾擺最上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy bottom, light top, like packing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ˈbɑtəm laɪt tɑp laɪk ˈpækɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 重的在下面，輕的在上面，像收拾行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pack like a person who travels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pæk laɪk ə ˈpɜrsən hu ˈtrævəlz./
dialogue.zh: 你收東西的樣子像常出遠門的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One wrinkled shirt, hang it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈrɪŋkəld ʃɜrt hæŋ ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件皺皺的襯衫，掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the door hook, it will relax overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə dɔr hʊk ɪt wɪl rɪˈlæks ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 掛在門鉤上，過夜就會自己平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now clean the drum, it is ours still.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ klin ðə drʌm ɪt ɪz ˈaʊərz stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 現在把滾筒清一清，還是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the glass, take your wet paper towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə ɡlæs teɪk jʊr wɛt ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 擦一下玻璃，用你那張濕紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave it clean for the next person.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt klin fɔr ðə nɛkst ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 留一個乾淨的機台給下一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The man with four bags is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæn wɪð fɔr bæɡz ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那個提四個袋子的男人在等了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give him the machine, take the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɪm ðə məˈʃin teɪk ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 把機器讓給他，我們收平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shelf is clear, basket is full, we are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛlf ɪz klɪr ˈbæskɪt ɪz fʊl wi ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 平台空了，籃子滿了，我們結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, done, done, say it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dʌn dʌn seɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 結束了，結束了，再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are done, and it is past ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr dʌn ənd ɪt ɪz pæst tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們結束了，而且已經過十點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past ten, and the rain did not stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst tɛn ənd ðə reɪn dɪd nɑt stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 過十點了，而且雨完全沒停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the window, it is a river.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪt ɪz ə ˈrɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 你看那窗外面，雨多得像一條河。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our basket is dry, we are not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt ɪz draɪ wi ɑr nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我們的籃子是乾的，我們不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we wait here and plan a route.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi weɪt hɪr ənd plæn ə raʊt./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們在這裡等，先想一條路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A route through the rain with clean clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə raʊt θru ðə reɪn wɪð klin kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 一條帶著乾淨衣服穿過雨的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One basket on your head, and run.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbæskɪt ɑn jʊr hɛd ənd rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 把籃子頂在頭上，然後用跑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rain is not stopping, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə reɪn ɪz nɑt ˈstɑpɪŋ si?/
dialogue.zh: 雨都沒有要停，你看到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is thicker than before, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈθɪkər ðæn bɪˈfɔr ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 其實還比剛才更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have no umbrella, zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv noʊ ʌmˈbrɛlə ˈzɪroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們一把傘都沒有，零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero, and one basket of dry clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪroʊ ənd wʌn ˈbæskɪt ɑv draɪ kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 零把傘，卻有一籃乾衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door is locked at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr ɪz lɑkt æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 大門十一點就上鎖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She just told us, ten more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʒʌst toʊld ʌs tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 她剛說我們還有十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes of waiting, then running.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɑv ˈweɪtɪŋ ðɛn ˈrʌnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 等十分鐘，然後用跑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run where? It is a long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn wɛr ɪt ɪz ə lɔŋ wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 跑到哪裡去？這段路還滿長的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner store first, it has a roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər stɔr fɜrst ɪt hæz ə rʊf./
dialogue.zh: 先到轉角那家店，它有屋頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A roof, yes, an awning over the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rʊf jɛs ən ˈɔnɪŋ ˈoʊvər ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 對，門口有一片遮雨的棚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An awning, that is our first stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈɔnɪŋ ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər fɜrst stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那片棚子就是我們的第一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the street, then our building door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə strit ðɛn ˈaʊər ˈbɪldɪŋ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 再來是馬路，然後是我們大樓的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our building has a big lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbɪldɪŋ hæz ə bɪɡ ˈlɑbi./
dialogue.zh: 我們那棟大樓有很寬的大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dry lobby, my favorite room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə draɪ ˈlɑbi maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt rum./
dialogue.zh: 乾的大廳，是我最喜歡的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is sweeping the floor now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈswipɪŋ ðə flɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她現在在掃地板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closing time sounds, the mop on tiles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊzɪŋ taɪm saʊndz ðə mɑp ɑn taɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 這是要關門的聲音，拖把在磁磚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights go off in two rows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɡoʊ ɑf ɪn tu roʊz./
dialogue.zh: 有兩排的燈關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half the room is dark already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə rum ɪz dɑrk ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 房間一半已經暗暗的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark and warm, like a cave at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk ənd wɔrm laɪk ə keɪv æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 又暗又暖，像晚上的洞穴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember the cave we talked about?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər ðə keɪv wi tɔkt əˈbaʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 還記得我們講過的那個洞穴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our basket is our turtle shell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt ɪz ˈaʊər ˈtɜrtəl ʃɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我們的籃子就是我們的烏龜殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A turtle with twelve folded socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɜrtəl wɪð twɛlv ˈfoʊldəd sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 一隻背著十二隻摺好襪子的烏龜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six pairs, do not say twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks pɛrz du nɑt seɪ twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 是六雙，不可以講十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve socks in six pairs, correct.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv sɑks ɪn sɪks pɛrz kəˈrɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 十二隻襪子，六雙，這樣就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, language is important at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ɪz ɪmˈpɔrtənt æt tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 很好，十點之後語言更要精準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Language and dry clothes, both matter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ənd draɪ kloʊz boʊθ ˈmætər./
dialogue.zh: 語言和乾衣服，兩樣都重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time, let us stand up.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm lɛt ʌs stænd ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 時間到了，我們站起來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Legs are stiff again, we sat too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛɡz ɑr stɪf əˈɡɛn wi sæt tu lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 腿又硬了，我們坐太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the door, the wind pushes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə dɔr ðə wɪnd pʊʃəz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 推門，風在往回推。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain comes sideways, close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn kʌmz ˈsaɪdweɪz kloʊz jʊr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 雨是斜著飛過來的，閉上眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One step out and my shoes are wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn stɛp aʊt ənd maɪ ʃuz ɑr wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 才踏出一步我的鞋就濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the basket, keep it above the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə ˈbæskɪt kip ɪt əˈbʌv ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 把籃子舉高，讓它離水面遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Over my head, like a table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvər maɪ hɛd laɪk ə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 頂在我頭上，像一張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run small, the store is only thirty steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn smɔl ðə stɔr ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈθɜrti stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 小跑步，那家店只有三十步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten steps, my shirt is soaked.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn stɛps maɪ ʃɜrt ɪz soʊkt./
dialogue.zh: 十步，我的襯衫已經全濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, almost there, keep it high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈɔlmoʊst ðɛr kip ɪt haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 二十步，快到了，舉高別放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, under the green awning!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈʌndər ðə ɡrin ˈɔnɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 到了，在綠色棚子下面！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry! Our basket is still dry!
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt ɪz stɪl draɪ!/
dialogue.zh: 乾的！我們的籃子一點都沒濕！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clothes win, we lose, fair trade.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz wɪn wi luz fɛr treɪd./
dialogue.zh: 衣服贏了，我們輸了，很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, wring your sleeve a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr rɪŋ jʊr sliv ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 公道啦，擰一下你的袖子吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wring? Here? On her shop front?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ hɪr ɑn hɜr ʃɑp frʌnt?/
dialogue.zh: 擰？在這裡？在她店門口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lady is smiling, so yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi ɪz ˈsmaɪlɪŋ soʊ jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 那位老闆娘在笑，所以可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She speaks, she says we can stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi spiks ʃi sɛz wi kæn steɪ./
dialogue.zh: 她開口了，說我們可以待一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until the rain thins, she says, ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənˈtɪl ðə reɪn θɪnz ʃi sɛz tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 她說等雨變小就好，十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes on a dry mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɑn ə draɪ mæt./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘，踩在一塊乾的地墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best mat in this whole town.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst mæt ɪn ðɪs hoʊl taʊn./
dialogue.zh: 是這個城裡最好的一塊地墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our basket sits like a king.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbæskɪt sɪts laɪk ə kɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的籃子坐在那裡像國王。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A king with folded towels inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɪŋ wɪð ˈfoʊldəd ˈtaʊəlz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 一位肚子裡裝滿毛巾的國王。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the street, it shines.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə strit ɪt ʃaɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 你看這條街，它在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every light is in the water twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri laɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 每盞燈都掉在水裡出現兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice the lights, half the people.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðə laɪts hæf ðə ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 燈多了一倍，人少了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cat, under that car, dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kæt ˈʌndər ðæt kɑr draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還有一隻貓，躲在車子底下，乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cat with a plan, staying put.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæt wɪð ə plæn ˈsteɪɪŋ pʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那貓有打算，就是不肯動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cats learn laundry, they sit for hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæts lɜrn ˈlɔndri ðeɪ sɪt fɔr ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 貓也懂洗衣，它們可以坐好幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We sat for hours tonight, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sæt fɔr ˈaʊərz təˈnaɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚也坐了好幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hours, and my back knows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈaʊərz ənd maɪ bæk noʊz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 三小時，我的背最清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes make a small sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz meɪk ə smɔl saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子在發出小小的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeak, squeak, wet socks are singing.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwik skwik wɛt sɑks ɑr ˈsɪŋɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 唧、唧，濕襪子正在唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet socks, the worst feeling now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt sɑks ðə wɜrst ˈfilɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 濕襪子，現在最難受的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change them when we get upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ ðɛm wɛn wi ɡɛt ˌʌpˈstɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 等上樓之後就換一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No diner, just dry socks, then tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdaɪnər dʒʌst draɪ sɑks ðɛn ti./
dialogue.zh: 不去餐館了，只要乾襪子，然後喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea and nothing else, no washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ənd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 只有茶，什麼都不要做了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rain is thinning, listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə reɪn ɪz ˈθɪnɪŋ ˈlɪsən./
dialogue.zh: 雨變細了，你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft now, drops instead of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft naʊ drɑps ɪnˈstɛd ɑv ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕的了，是一滴一滴不是水柱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now or never, the last run.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɔr ˈnɛvər ðə læst rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 就現在吧，最後衝一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the basket with both hands high.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈbæskɪt wɪð boʊθ hændz haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 兩手把籃子高高舉住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cross here, the walk sign is lit.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɔs hɪr ðə wɔk saɪn ɪz lɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡過馬路，走路指標亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the red hand is up.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə rɛd hænd ɪz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 先別走，紅色的手掌亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, now the man is walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr naʊ ðə mæn ɪz ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在小人開始走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go, fast, but do not drop the towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ fæst bʌt du nɑt drɑp ðə ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 走，快一點，但別弄掉了毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not dropping them, not tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈdrɑpɪŋ ðɛm nɑt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 才不會掉，今晚絕對不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost at our door, one puddle left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst æt ˈaʊər dɔr wʌn ˈpʌdəl lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 快到我們門口了，只剩一個水坑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jump it? The puddle is wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌmp ɪt ðə ˈpʌdəl ɪz waɪd./
dialogue.zh: 跳過去？那水坑好寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk around, we are not heroes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk əˈraʊnd wi ɑr nɑt hɪˈroʊz./
dialogue.zh: 繞過去吧，我們又不是英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not heroes, just tired laundry people.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪˈroʊz dʒʌst ˈtaɪərd ˈlɔndri ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 不是英雄，只是累的洗衣人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired people with twelve dry socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ˈpipəl wɪð twɛlv draɪ sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 累卻擁有十二隻乾襪子的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Building key, my pocket, here it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪldɪŋ ki maɪ ˈpɑkɪt hɪr ɪt ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 大門鑰匙在我口袋裡，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the big door, we are home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə bɪɡ dɔr wi ɑr hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 拉開那扇大門，我們到家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lobby smells like rain and soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɑbi smɛlz laɪk reɪn ənd soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 大廳聞起來像雨和肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our soap came home with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər soʊp keɪm hoʊm wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我們的洗衣精跟著我們回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elevator or stairs tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɔr stɛrz təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚要坐電梯還是走樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stairs, two floors, we have warm clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛrz tu flɔrz wi hæv wɔrm kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 走樓梯，兩層樓，我們有暖暖的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two floors, one basket, slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu flɔrz wʌn ˈbæskɪt sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 兩層樓、一籃東西，慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop twice, I am breathing hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp twaɪs aɪ æm ˈbriðɪŋ hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 中途停兩次吧，我氣喘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our door, at last, unlock it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər dɔr æt læst ʌnˈlɑk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們家的門，終於，開鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside! Take the basket off your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd teɪk ðə ˈbæskɪt ɑf jʊr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 進來了！把籃子從頭上拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home, dry floor, soft light.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm draɪ flɔr sɔft laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 到家了，乾的地板，柔和的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, and let the wet clothes drip.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ənd lɛt ðə wɛt kloʊz drɪp./
dialogue.zh: 坐下，讓濕衣服自己滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the folded stack away.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈfoʊldəd stæk əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 把摺好的那一疊收進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Socks in the top drawer, shirts on hooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑks ɪn ðə tɑp drɔr ʃɜrts ɑn hʊks./
dialogue.zh: 襪子放最上層的抽屜，襯衫掛勾上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wrinkled shirt, on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɪŋkəld ʃɜrt ɑn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那件皺的襯衫，掛在門後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hung up, by tomorrow it will be flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌŋ ʌp baɪ təˈmɑroʊ ɪt wɪl bi flæt./
dialogue.zh: 掛起來，到明天就平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything in its place, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪn ɪts pleɪs lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 每樣東西都定位了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the found coin, on the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə faʊnd kɔɪn ɑn ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 連那枚撿到的硬幣，也放在罐子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten fifty, tea, and bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈfɪfti ti ənd bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 十點五十，喝茶，然後睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm cup, warm shirt, dry hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm kʌp wɔrm ʃɜrt draɪ hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 暖的杯子、暖的襯衫、乾的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine sound is still in me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin saʊnd ɪz stɪl ɪn mi./
dialogue.zh: 機器的聲音還留在我身體裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hum, hum, like rain, like sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm hʌm laɪk reɪn laɪk slip./
dialogue.zh: 嗡、嗡，像雨聲，像睡意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we fold nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ wi foʊld ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 明天我們什麼都不要摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the clean clothes are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ðə klin kloʊz ɑr ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 明天乾淨的衣服就已經備好了。
